narrative.text: The title page of the Chinese translation of WHO's training manual on ethics in epidemics, emergencies and disasters, covering research, surveillance and patient care, with a list of translators and reviewers from Zhejiang and Hubei.
世界卫生组织《疾病流行、突发事件和灾害中的伦理学：研究、监测和病人治疗 培训手册》中译本的书名页，列出来自浙江和湖北的译者及审校者名单。
The copyright and cataloguing page of the 2018 Chinese edition of WHO's 2015 manual on ethics in epidemics, emergencies and disasters, with publisher details, translation rights and ISBN.
世界卫生组织2015年手册《疾病流行、突发事件和灾害中的伦理学》2018年中文版的版权页和编目页，载有出版者信息、翻译授权及ISBN。

The translators' preface explains that recent outbreaks such as SARS, avian influenza, Ebola and Zika and natural disasters raise ethical problems for responders, and that this WHO manual fills a gap. It outlines the manual's two parts, on research and surveillance and on patient care, organized as modules with 7 core competencies and 26 learning objectives.
译者序指出，近年来SARS、禽流感、埃博拉、寨卡等疫情暴发以及自然灾害给应对人员带来伦理难题，而这本WHO手册填补了这一空白。序言概述了手册的两个部分（研究和监测；病人治疗），各部分以模块编排，共有7项核心能力和26个学习目标。

The second page of the translators' preface describes the manual as practical and suitable for both developed and developing countries, and lists its intended readers. It thanks WHO and the translators and is signed in August 2017.
译者序第二页称本书实用性强，既适用于发达国家也适用于发展中国家，并列出其适用读者。译者向WHO及各位译者致谢，落款时间为2017年8月。
Lists the first contributing authors of the original manual with their institutions in Canada, Switzerland and the United States, in English with Chinese translations.
列出原著第一批作者及其在加拿大、瑞士和美国的所属机构，英文原文附中文译名。
Continues the list of contributing authors and their affiliations, including universities in Miami, Montreal, Birmingham and Dublin.
续列原著作者及其所属机构，包括迈阿密、蒙特利尔、伯明翰和都柏林的大学。
Continues the list of contributors with affiliations, including Montreal, Monash, McMaster and Toronto universities.
续列原著作者及所属机构，包括蒙特利尔大学、莫纳什大学、麦克马斯特大学和多伦多大学。
Completes the list of contributing authors, with affiliations at Southampton and Montreal universities.
原著作者名单的最后一页，所属机构包括南安普敦大学和蒙特利尔大学。

Opens the acknowledgements, explaining that the manual came from collaboration between several WHO departments and grew from a 2009 WHO technical consultation on research ethics in outbreak response. It thanks the editor, coordinators and those who drafted learning objectives and provided materials.
致谢开篇说明，本手册由WHO多个部门合作完成，源于2009年WHO关于疾病暴发应对中研究伦理的技术磋商。致谢对象包括主编、协调员以及编写学习目标和提供资料的人员。
Continues the acknowledgements, thanking the module authors and organizations that allowed adaptation of material. It also lists the many external reviewers by name and institution.
致谢续页，感谢各模块作者和允许改编资料的机构，并按姓名和机构列出众多外部评审人员。

Completes the acknowledgements, thanking WHO staff and interns who contributed. It notes that drafts were field tested at workshops run by the International Federation of Medical Students' Associations and at a 2015 seminar on Ebola research ethics.
致谢最后一页，感谢参与工作的WHO工作人员和实习生。文中指出，初稿曾在国际医学生联合会举办的研讨班以及2015年埃博拉研究伦理研讨会上进行现场测试。
The first page of the table of contents, listing the introduction, overview and the research and surveillance section with core competencies 1 and 2 and their learning objectives.
目录第一页，列出导言、概述以及研究和监测部分的核心能力1和2及其学习目标。
Continues the table of contents with learning objectives under core competencies 3, 4 and 5 on surveillance, research consent, privacy and publication ethics.
目录续页，列出核心能力3、4、5下关于监测、研究知情同意、隐私和发表伦理的学习目标。
Completes the table of contents with core competencies 6 and 7 on triage, standards of care and health workers' duties, followed by a glossary and annex.
目录最后一页，列出关于检伤分类、治疗规范和卫生工作者义务的核心能力6和7，以及术语表和附件。

Opens the introduction, saying the manual addresses ethical issues in research, surveillance and patient care during epidemics and disasters. It traces the manual to a 2010 WHO consultation report and summarizes the experts' main positions on research ethics and oversight in emergencies.
导言开篇说明，本手册探讨疾病流行和灾害期间研究、监测和病人治疗中的伦理问题。导言追溯手册源自2010年WHO磋商报告，并概述专家们关于突发事件中研究伦理和监督的主要立场。

Continues the introduction, noting the International Health Regulations and the lack of consensus on other ethical norms in emergencies. It explains how the manual uses the terms emergency and disaster broadly, based on a community's capacity to cope.
导言续页提到《国际卫生条例》，并指出突发事件中其他伦理规范尚缺乏共识。文中说明手册依据社区的应对能力，对“突发事件”和“灾害”采用广义定义。

Describes types of hazards and explains how to use the manual, with its two parts, modular units, case studies and slides. Trainers can pick modules to suit learners, and the materials are aimed at field epidemiologists, responders, public health staff, researchers and policy-makers.
介绍各类危害，并说明手册的使用方法：两个部分、模块化单元、案例研究和幻灯片。教员可根据学员情况选择模块，材料面向现场流行病学人员、应对人员、公共卫生人员、研究人员和决策者。
A short page with headings for the introduction's references and further reading and a translator credit.
简短的一页，仅有导言的“参考文献”和“其他读物”标题以及译校署名。

Gives the 90-minute session plan for the overview module on ethics in epidemics, emergencies and disasters. Trainers deliver a plenary presentation and then invite open questions and learners' own experiences.
给出“概述：疾病流行、突发事件和灾害情况下的伦理学”模块90分钟的课程时间表。教员先作大会报告，再组织公开提问并请学员分享自身经历。

Describes group work for the overview session, where one group drafts guidelines for allocating intravenous fluids and another designs a study. It introduces a case study of a viral haemorrhagic fever outbreak in which a health centre has too few intravenous fluids.
介绍概述课程的小组活动：一组起草静脉补液分配指南，另一组设计一项研究。随后引入一个病毒性出血热暴发的案例，其中卫生保健中心的静脉补液严重不足。

Continues the haemorrhagic fever case study, in which a nurse must help set priorities for intravenous fluids and decide whether to give a scarce experimental treatment. It lists prompting questions for trainers on who decides and on allocation by need, severity and survival chances.
出血热案例续篇：一名护士须协助确定静脉补液的优先顺序，并决定是否使用数量有限的实验性治疗。本页列出供教员使用的引导问题，涉及由谁决策以及按需要、严重程度和存活机会进行分配。

Adds questions on appeals and communicating allocation policy. It then presents a second case study in which a consortium asks a health centre to host a first-in-human trial of an antiviral during a haemorrhagic fever outbreak, with prompting questions on study design.
补充关于上诉和沟通分配政策的问题。随后给出第二个案例：出血热暴发期间，一个联合体请某卫生保健中心承担一种抗病毒药物的首次人体试验，并附有关于研究设计的引导问题。

Lists further questions for the clinical trial case study, covering recruitment, informed consent, effects on non-participants, health workers' dual roles, publication of results and obligations to the community.
列出临床试验案例的更多问题，涉及招募、知情同意、对未参与者的影响、卫生工作者的双重角色、结果发表以及对社区的义务。
A blank page with no extracted text.
空白页，未提取到文字。
A section divider page for the research and surveillance part of the manual.
手册“研究和监测”部分的分隔页。
The divider page for core competency 1, on analysing the boundary between public health practice, including surveillance, and research during emergencies.
核心能力1的分隔页，主题是分析突发事件期间公共卫生实践（包括监测）与研究之间的界限。

Introduces core competency 1, explaining that the usual distinction between public health practice and research decides whether ethical oversight is needed, while experts move toward risk-based approaches. It lists learning objectives 1.1 to 1.4.
介绍核心能力1，说明公共卫生实践与研究之间的通常区分决定了是否需要伦理学监督，而专家们正逐渐转向基于风险的方法。本页列出学习目标1.1至1.4。

Opens learning objective 1.1 on distinguishing public health surveillance from research, with a 60-minute session plan. Trainers present slides, hand out scenarios and run small-group discussion and reporting.
学习目标1.1（区分公共卫生监测与研究）开篇，附60分钟课程时间表。教员展示幻灯片、分发情景材料，并组织小组讨论和汇报。

Sets out background on public health and surveillance, describing surveillance as a core public health activity closely related to research. It quotes a US CDC definition and notes that informed consent, central to research ethics, is often not required for surveillance.
介绍公共卫生和监测的背景，将监测描述为与研究密切相关的公共卫生核心活动。文中引用美国CDC的定义，并指出作为研究伦理核心的知情同意对监测而言往往并非必需。

Notes that research ethics has extensive guidance and oversight while surveillance ethics lacks international standards. It then examines how research and surveillance can be told apart, and outlines the US CDC approach based on an activity's primary intent.
指出研究伦理已有大量指南和监督机制，而监测伦理缺乏国际标准。随后探讨如何区分研究与监测，并概述美国CDC以活动主要意图为依据的做法。

Critiques the US CDC distinction based on intent to produce generalizable knowledge, asking how intent is determined and why it should matter ethically. It then raises the question of what, if anything, makes research and surveillance ethically different.
批评美国CDC以是否旨在产生可推广知识为依据的区分方法，质疑意图如何确定以及为何在伦理上具有意义。随后提出问题：研究与监测在伦理上究竟有何不同。

Argues that the ethically relevant factors are risks to participants' interests and rights and the expected public health benefit, so similar activities should be treated alike. It opens an Ebola outbreak case study with questions about collecting blood samples from isolated patients.
论证伦理上相关的因素是对受试者利益和权利的风险以及预期的公共卫生收益，因此类似活动应同等对待。随后开始一个埃博拉暴发案例，提出从隔离患者身上采集血样的相关问题。

Continues the Ebola case study with questions on saliva and bone marrow sampling, testing an experimental drug without an ethics committee, and conducting autopsies amid community rumours. A summary begins by noting that most jurisdictions still treat surveillance and research differently.
埃博拉案例续篇，提出关于采集唾液和骨髓标本、未经伦理委员会测试实验药物以及在社区谣言中进行尸检的问题。小结开头指出，大多数司法管辖区仍对监测和研究区别对待。

Concludes learning objective 1.1 by noting the lack of overall guidance on surveillance ethics and advising managers and researchers to consult an ethics committee when in doubt, followed by reference headings.
学习目标1.1的结尾指出，监测伦理缺乏总体指南，建议规划管理者和研究人员在有疑问时咨询伦理委员会，随后为参考文献标题。

Opens learning objective 1.2 on identifying which emergency response activities count as research needing ethics review, with a 90-minute session plan. Trainers introduce research ethics committees, hand out a reading and set small groups to plan activities of different types.
学习目标1.2（确定突发事件应对中哪些活动属于需要伦理审查的研究）开篇，附90分钟课程时间表。教员介绍研究伦理委员会、分发阅读材料，并让各小组规划不同类型的活动。

Describes how groups present their planned activities for discussion of whether they are research or public health practice. The background explains that research generally needs independent ethics review and traces the many codes that followed the 1947 Nuremberg Code.
说明各小组如何展示所规划的活动，供大家讨论其属于研究还是公共卫生实践。背景部分解释研究一般需要独立伦理审查，并追溯1947年《纽伦堡法典》之后出台的众多准则。

Explains that the depth of ethics review should match a study's risk and the vulnerability of participants, and that procedures can be adapted for timely review in emergencies. It lists research priorities in disasters, such as health facility management, mental health, nutrition and communicable diseases.
说明伦理审查的详细程度应与研究风险及受试者的脆弱性相称，突发事件中可调整程序以便及时审查。本页列出灾害中的研究重点，如卫生机构管理、精神卫生、营养和传染病。

Describes types of research possible in emergencies, including health services and systems research, population-based studies and knowledge translation research, with examples. It notes that some designs, such as randomized trials of investigational products, may be unsuitable during an emergency.
介绍突发事件中可开展的研究类型，包括卫生服务和卫生系统研究、基于人群的研究和知识转化研究，并举例说明。文中指出某些设计（如研究性产品的随机试验）可能不适合在突发事件期间进行。
A short closing passage noting that the context of an emergency may limit research more than rules do, followed by a references heading.
简短的结束段落指出，突发事件的环境对研究的限制可能比相关规则的限制更大，随后为参考文献标题。
A page with a further reading heading and a translator credit.
仅有“其他读物”标题和译校署名的一页。

Opens learning objective 1.3 on ethical principles and requirements in current research and surveillance norms, with a 90-minute session plan. Trainers ask about learners' experience of research ethics guidelines and give two groups readings on what makes clinical research ethical.
学习目标1.3（说明突发事件时研究和监测相关最新规范中的伦理原则和要求）开篇，附90分钟课程时间表。教员询问学员在研究伦理指南方面的经验，并给两个小组分发关于临床研究如何才符合伦理的阅读材料。

Ends the teaching steps and gives background on ethical issues in research involving humans, such as protection of participants, informed consent and integrity. It traces research ethics guidelines back to the Nuremberg trials and the 1947 code.
教学步骤的结尾，以及关于涉及人体研究中伦理问题（如受试者保护、知情同意和诚信）的背景介绍。文中将研究伦理指南追溯到纽伦堡审判和1947年的法典。

Begins a table of core ethical principles in major guidelines with examples of how they apply in emergencies, covering respect for autonomy and informed consent. It cites CIOMS guidelines, the Canadian Tri-Council policy, the Belmont Report and the Declaration of Helsinki.
开始列出主要指南中的核心伦理原则表格，并举例说明其在突发事件中的应用，涵盖尊重自主权和知情同意。表中引用了国际医学科学组织委员会（CIOMS）指南、加拿大三大理事会政策声明、贝尔蒙报告和赫尔辛基宣言。

Continues the table of ethical principles, covering beneficence, non-maleficence and justice, with emergency examples such as pandemic vaccine access and trial size. Each principle is linked to relevant CIOMS and Helsinki provisions.
伦理原则表格续表，涵盖受益、不伤害和公平，并举出突发事件中的例子，如大流行时获得疫苗和试验规模。每项原则都对应CIOMS指南和赫尔辛基宣言的相关条款。

Continues the table with vulnerability and privacy, giving examples such as surveillance aimed at women and children without justification and interviewing disaster victims in private. Relevant guideline provisions are cited for each.
表格续表涉及脆弱性和隐私，举例包括无正当理由针对妇女和儿童开展监测、私下访谈灾害受害者等。每项均引用了相关指南条款。

Notes that the principles in the table apply to all researchers but may need to be adapted to context, and that research can help public health responders assess and plan for emergencies. It states that research on humans in emergencies must meet the same ethical standards as elsewhere, then begins a history of research ethics.
指出表中原则适用于所有研究者，但可能需要结合具体背景调整；研究可帮助公共卫生应对人员评估和规划突发事件。文中强调，突发事件中的人体研究必须符合与其他情况相同的伦理标准，随后开始回顾研究伦理的历史。

Recounts how the Nuremberg trials produced the ten principles of the Nuremberg Code and how later guidelines were issued by national bodies, professional groups and UN agencies. It then introduces the 1964 Declaration of Helsinki and its broader treatment of issues such as informed consent.
讲述纽伦堡审判如何产生纽伦堡法典的十项原则，以及此后国家机构、专业团体和联合国机构如何发布相关指南。随后介绍1964年赫尔辛基宣言及其对知情同意等问题更全面的论述。

Summarizes the Belmont Report's three principles of respect for persons, beneficence and justice. It then describes the US Common Rule governing federally funded research and recent moves to revise it.
概括贝尔蒙报告的三项原则：尊重受试者、受益和公平。随后介绍规范联邦资助研究的美国《共同规则》以及近期对其修订的动向。

Describes the CIOMS international ethical guidelines for biomedical research, first issued in 1982 and revised in 1993 and 2002. It lists the main topics they cover, such as ethical justification, ethics review committees, externally sponsored research, consent and inducements.
介绍国际医学科学组织委员会（CIOMS）关于生物医学研究的国际伦理指南，该指南于1982年首次发布，1993年和2002年修订。文中列出其涵盖的主要议题，如伦理正当性、伦理审查委员会、外部资助研究、同意和诱导。

Lists the topics emphasized in the 2010 Canadian Tri-Council Policy Statement, from consent and privacy to research with Indigenous peoples and human genetics. It mentions other guidelines relevant to developing countries and begins a summary on research and surveillance in emergencies.
列出2010年加拿大三大理事会政策声明所强调的议题，从同意和隐私到涉及原住民和人类遗传学的研究。文中提及与发展中国家相关的其他指南，并开始对突发事件中的研究和监测进行小结。

Summarizes that research ethics documents broadly agree on core principles such as autonomy, consent, justice, privacy and ethics review, while disagreeing on placebo use, vulnerable groups and whether emergency interventions count as research.
小结指出，各研究伦理文件在自主权、同意、公平、隐私和伦理审查等核心原则上大体一致，但在安慰剂使用、脆弱群体以及突发事件干预是否属于研究等问题上存在分歧。
A page containing only a further reading heading.
仅有“其他读物”标题的一页。
A page containing only a translator credit.
仅有译校署名的一页。

Opens learning objective 1.4 on the shortcomings of current norms in emergencies and possible alternatives, with a 120-minute session plan. Trainers review the main guidelines and ask learners whether they suit emergencies.
学习目标1.4（确定突发事件情况下现行规范的不足并评价其他方法）开篇，附120分钟课程时间表。教员回顾主要指南，并询问学员这些指南是否适用于突发事件。

Lists ethical issues trainers should draw out of the case study, including children's vulnerability, consent across language barriers, confidentiality and conflicts of interest. Learners then report back and read part of the WHO report on research ethics in outbreak response.
列出教员应从案例研究中引出的伦理问题，包括儿童的脆弱性、语言障碍下的知情同意、保密以及利益冲突。随后学员汇报讨论结果，并阅读WHO关于疾病暴发应对中研究伦理报告的部分内容。

Notes that many research ethics guidelines arose in response to scandals such as the Nazi experiments and the Tuskegee study and were written mostly in Europe and North America. It reports criticism that they suit stable, well-resourced clinical research and are hard to follow in disruptive emergencies in low-resource settings.
指出许多研究伦理指南是为回应纳粹试验和Tuskegee研究等丑闻而制定的，且大多出自欧洲和北美。文中提到有批评认为，这些指南适用于稳定且资源充足的临床研究，在资源匮乏地区动荡的突发事件中难以遵循。

Discusses how emergencies offer chances for time-limited research involving affected people, raising confidentiality concerns. It explains that perceptions of risk and benefit may shift in emergencies, when people may seek any help regardless of risk.
讨论突发事件如何为涉及受累人群的限时研究提供机会，同时引发保密方面的担忧。文中解释，在突发事件中人们对风险和受益的认识可能改变，此时人们可能不顾风险寻求任何帮助。

Notes WHO's view that offering unproven interventions during outbreaks can be ethically required, and that guidelines say little about how emergencies affect consent. It then turns to the roles and relationships between researchers and participants.
指出WHO认为在疾病暴发期间提供未经证实的干预措施在伦理上可能是必要的，而指南对突发事件如何影响知情同意论述甚少。随后转向研究者与受试者之间的角色和关系。

Notes that guidelines require research to be supervised by qualified researchers, but in emergencies it may be unclear what counts as research and who is a researcher. It then raises research integrity and conflicts of interest as a threat to public trust.
指出指南要求研究由有资质的研究者监督，但在突发事件中可能难以确定什么属于研究以及谁是研究者。随后提出研究诚信和利益冲突问题，认为其威胁公众信任。

Discusses evidence of mishandled expert conflicts of interest and contentious debates over allocating scarce vaccines. It notes calls for accountability, honesty and transparency to prevent misuse of the emergency label for private gain.
讨论有证据表明专家利益冲突处理不当，以及围绕稀缺疫苗分配的激烈争论。文中提到有人呼吁问责、诚实和透明，以防借“突发事件”之名谋取私利。

Lists options for adapting ethics oversight in emergencies, such as separating critical from non-critical tasks, proportionate and rapid review, pre-prepared protocols and rolling review. It introduces a case study on the Trovan trial in Nigeria.
列出在突发事件中调整伦理监督的方案，如区分关键与非关键任务、比例性快速审查、预先准备的方案和滚动审查。随后介绍尼日利亚Trovan试验的案例研究。

Summarizes the shortcomings of current research ethics guidelines for emergencies, including their clinical focus and demanding review models. It urges public health workers to seek workable alternatives without using emergencies as an excuse to lower ethical standards.
概括现行研究伦理指南在突发事件中的不足，包括偏重临床以及审查模式要求过高。文中敦促公共卫生工作者寻找可行的替代方法，但不得以突发事件为借口降低伦理标准。
A page containing only a translator credit.
仅有译校署名的一页。
The divider page for core competency 2, on choosing appropriate ethics review procedures for public health interventions, surveillance and research during emergencies.
核心能力2的分隔页，主题是在突发事件期间为公共卫生干预、监测和研究确定适当的伦理审查程序。
Introduces core competency 2 and lists its three learning objectives on standard review procedures, when surveillance needs formal review, and adapted review procedures for emergencies.
介绍核心能力2，并列出其三个学习目标：标准审查程序、监测何时需要正式审查，以及适用于突发事件的调整后审查程序。

Opens learning objective 2.1 on standard ethics review procedures for research, with a 90-minute session plan. Trainers contrast biomedical and public health research and have groups debate whether review standards should ever change.
学习目标2.1（研究的标准伦理审查程序）开篇，附90分钟课程时间表。教员对比生物医学研究和公共卫生研究，并让各小组辩论审查标准是否应有所改变。

Has groups discuss why ethics oversight is worth its cost and time and whether committee approval must be unanimous. The background notes that health research aims at generalizable knowledge but is hard to separate from public health practice in emergencies.
让各小组讨论伦理监督为何值得付出成本和时间，以及委员会批准是否必须一致通过。背景部分指出，卫生研究旨在获得可推广的知识，但在突发事件中很难与公共卫生实践区分开来。

Sets out the responsibilities of research ethics committees and principles such as low risk, fair participant selection and informed consent. It states that independent prospective ethics review of human research is now widely accepted.
阐述研究伦理委员会的职责以及低风险、公平选择受试者和知情同意等原则。文中指出，对人体研究进行独立的前瞻性伦理审查如今已被广泛接受。

Lists eleven areas that ethics review of research, including in emergencies, should cover, from social value and consent to dissemination and institutional arrangements. It gives examples of questions committees may ask about risks, consent, confidentiality and vulnerable groups.
列出研究（包括突发事件期间的研究）伦理审查应涵盖的11个方面，从社会价值和知情同意到结果传播和机构安排。文中举例说明委员会可能就风险、同意、保密和脆弱群体提出的问题。

Explains how ethics review of public health research differs from clinical research, such as concern for group harms, possible waivers of consent and issues of group privacy. It notes that committees reviewing such research need epidemiological expertise and more community members.
解释公共卫生研究的伦理审查与临床研究有何不同，如关注群体伤害、可能豁免知情同意以及群体隐私问题。文中指出，审查此类研究的委员会需要流行病学专业知识和更多社区成员。

Discusses the need for public health expertise and community representatives on ethics committees, which may be hard in emergencies. It also explains that committees may approve altered research standards in emergencies, as with altered standards of care.
讨论伦理委员会需要公共卫生专家和社区代表，而这在突发事件中可能难以做到。文中还解释，与调整后的治疗规范一样，委员会在突发事件中可批准调整后的研究标准。

Presents a case study on US CDC efforts during the 2003 SARS outbreak to trace airline passengers exposed to suspected cases, with delays of several weeks in getting passenger lists. It raises whether such activities needed ethics review.
介绍一个案例：2003年SARS暴发期间，美国CDC努力追踪接触疑似病例的航空乘客，但获取乘客名单延误了数周。案例提出此类活动是否需要伦理审查的问题。
A page with the end of a sentence and headings for references and further reading.
仅有一句话的结尾以及参考文献和其他读物标题的一页。
A page containing only a translator credit.
仅有译校署名的一页。

Opens learning objective 2.2 on when public health surveillance should get formal ethics review, with a 75-minute session plan. Trainers stress the difference between law and ethics and introduce a case study.
学习目标2.2（确定公共卫生监测何时应接受正式伦理审查）开篇，附75分钟课程时间表。教员强调法律与伦理的区别，并介绍一个案例研究。

Gives further case study questions and has groups discuss which surveillance needs formal review and which does not. The background calls the line between public health practice and research one of the hardest questions in bioethics.
给出更多案例问题，并让各小组讨论哪些监测需要正式审查、哪些不需要。背景部分称，公共卫生实践与研究之间的界限是生命伦理学中最难的问题之一。

Notes that risk is one criterion for deciding whether review is needed and that much surveillance collects data without people's knowledge. It describes the ethical basis for overseeing surveillance and begins listing factors to consider.
指出风险是决定是否需要审查的标准之一，而许多监测是在人们不知情的情况下收集数据。文中阐述监督监测活动的伦理依据，并开始列出需要考虑的因素。

Argues that public trust underpins surveillance and can be damaged, as when HIV data were used to isolate people in the 1980s and 1990s. It suggests the main reason for formal review of surveillance may be to strengthen trust.
论证公众信任是监测的基础且可能遭到破坏，例如20世纪80至90年代曾利用HIV数据隔离人群。文中提出，对监测进行正式审查的主要理由可能在于增强信任。

Gives further reasons for formal review of surveillance, including protecting vulnerable groups such as children, prisoners and minorities. It cautions that overuse of review could block surveillance and that other legal protections sometimes suffice.
进一步说明对监测进行正式审查的理由，包括保护儿童、囚犯和少数民族等弱势群体。文中提醒，过度审查可能妨碍监测，有时其他法律保护已经足够。
Describes a hospital nutrition project case study in which patients' protein markers are tested and results are shared with one group but not the other, comparing clinical outcomes.
介绍一个医院营养项目案例：对患者的蛋白质指标进行检测，其中一组获知结果而另一组不获知，并比较临床结局。

Summarizes that formal review of surveillance can build trust and offer guidance, and that a risk-based approach is favoured over the traditional definition of research, followed by reference headings and translator credit.
小结指出，对监测进行正式审查有助于建立信任并提供指导，与传统的研究定义相比更倾向于基于风险的方法，随后为参考文献标题和译校署名。

Opens learning objective 2.3 on possible changes to standard ethics review for research in emergencies, with a 75-minute session plan. Learners review standard procedures and discuss in small groups whether they suit emergency research.
学习目标2.3（描述突发事件情况下研究伦理审查标准程序的可能变化）开篇，附75分钟课程时间表。学员回顾标准程序，并分小组讨论其是否适用于突发事件中的研究。

Lists case study questions on whether a project is research or surveillance and whether review procedures should be modified or expedited. The background says the enduring aim of ethics review is to find the least harmful way to do research.
列出案例问题：项目属于研究还是监测，审查程序是否应修改或加快。背景部分指出，伦理审查的永恒目标是找到危害最小的研究方式。

Notes that existing guidelines may not cover all emergency issues and that standard procedures may need some flexibility. It discusses the debated assumption that vulnerability increases during emergencies.
指出现有指南可能无法涵盖突发事件中的所有问题，标准程序可能需要一定的灵活性。文中讨论了突发事件期间脆弱性增加这一有争议的假设。

Argues that disaster research needs rigorous, continuous ethics review and that the challenge is to protect dignity while benefiting society. It lists possible changes such as expedited review, proportionate review, pre-approved generic protocols and proactive review, starting with expedited review.
论证灾害研究需要严格、持续的伦理审查，挑战在于既保护尊严又造福社会。文中列出可能的变化，如加速审查、比例性审查、预先批准的通用方案和主动审查，并首先介绍加速审查。

Describes pre-approval of protocols for recurring emergencies and the option of exempting routine needs assessments from review. It warns that exemptions can harm coordination, citing multiple needs assessments after the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami.
介绍为周期性突发事件预先批准研究方案，以及豁免常规需求评估审查的做法。文中警告豁免可能损害协调，并以2004年印度洋海啸后重复开展的多项需求评估为例。

Notes that departing from normal review standards may be ethically allowed or even needed in emergencies, and cites frameworks proposed for this. One framework combines extra vigilance with procedural flexibility in line with perceived risk.
指出在突发事件中偏离常规审查标准在伦理上可能是允许的，甚至是必要的，并引用为此提出的若干框架。其中一个框架主张根据所感知的风险，将更高警惕与程序灵活性相结合。

Presents a case study of fast-track review by a small committee of a new vaccine trial for a deadly pathogen, with vaccine handed out at retail outlets without community consent. Information leaflets and text messages would inform people, with ongoing data review.
介绍一个案例：由小型委员会快速审查针对致命病原体的新疫苗试验，疫苗在零售网点发放而未征得社区同意。将通过宣传单和短信告知民众，并持续审查数据。

Ends a case study on syndromic surveillance after an attack, where identifiable purchase and attendance data are collected without consent. The summary recaps pre-approved protocols, expedited review and exemptions, noting that speed should not mean weaker review.
一个关于袭击后症状监测的案例的结尾，其中在未经同意的情况下收集了可识别个人身份的购药和就诊数据。小结回顾预先批准方案、加速审查和豁免，强调加快速度不应意味着削弱审查。
A page containing only a further reading heading.
仅有“其他读物”标题的一页。
A page containing only a translator credit.
仅有译校署名的一页。

The divider page for core competency 3, on conflicts between public good and individual autonomy in surveillance, with a photo caption from an Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo in 2007.
核心能力3的分隔页，主题是监测中公共利益与个体自主权的冲突，并附有2007年刚果民主共和国埃博拉应对现场的照片说明。

Introduces core competency 3, noting that public health activities can harm individuals and communities as well as benefit them. It lists learning objectives on harms and benefits, informed consent, privacy, protection of biological materials, and when public good may override autonomy.
介绍核心能力3，指出公共卫生活动既能使个人和社区受益，也可能对其造成危害。本页列出关于危害和利益、知情同意、隐私、生物学材料保护以及公共利益何时可优先于自主权的学习目标。

Opens learning objective 3.1 on harms and benefits of public health activities and surveillance, with a 105-minute session plan. Learners first write and share answers on when quarantine is ethically justified.
学习目标3.1（公共卫生活动和监测的危害和利益）开篇，附105分钟课程时间表。学员首先写下并分享对检疫何时在伦理上合理的回答。

Lists the next teaching steps, including reading an article on lessons from the 1976 swine flu vaccine scare and weighing harms and benefits of a new flu vaccine. Groups then discuss a case study about surveillance that could lead to stigma.
列出后续教学步骤，包括阅读一篇关于1976年猪流感疫苗恐慌教训的文章，并权衡一种新流感疫苗的危害和利益。随后各小组讨论一个可能导致污名化的监测案例。

Describes the varied benefits of public health activities and surveillance and the harms they can cause, such as compulsory collection of samples. It contrasts clinical medicine, where one patient bears both risks and benefits, with public health.
阐述公共卫生活动和监测的多种益处及其可能造成的危害，如强制采集标本。文中将风险和受益由同一患者承担的临床医学与公共卫生进行了对比。

Discusses compulsory programmes, noting that loss of public trust, as in the 2014 Ebola outbreak, makes them harder. It weighs debate over mandatory vaccination and notes that political and ethical theories value harms and benefits differently.
讨论强制性项目，指出公众失去信任（如2014年埃博拉暴发期间）会使其更难实施。文中权衡关于强制接种疫苗的争论，并指出不同的政治和伦理理论对危害和利益的评价不同。

Continues the training manual's discussion of the benefits of public health surveillance during emergencies, such as herd immunity, better use of health resources and research opportunities. It then lists potential harms, including adverse effects (citing the 1976 swine flu vaccine and Guillain-Barré syndrome) and loss of privacy or confidentiality.
手册继续讨论突发事件期间公共卫生监测的益处，如群体免疫、更有效地利用卫生资源以及研究机会。随后列出潜在危害，包括不良反应（以1976年猪流感疫苗和格林-巴利综合征为例）以及隐私或保密的丧失。

Describes further potential harms of surveillance and public health action, including stigma for individuals and communities (with examples from HIV/AIDS and Ebola) and violations of rights in the name of the public good. It refers to the Siracusa Principles as guidance on limiting human rights for public health reasons and begins to discuss wasted resources.
阐述监测和公共卫生行动的其他潜在危害，包括个人和社区蒙受耻辱（以HIV/艾滋病和埃博拉为例）以及以公共利益之名侵犯权利。文中提到《锡拉库萨原则》可作为出于公共卫生理由限制人权的指导，并开始讨论资源浪费问题。

Notes that poorly planned data collection wastes limited resources and summarises strategies to minimise surveillance harms, such as collecting minimal data, building trust early and protecting data. It then opens a case study from a southern African country where clinic records showed far more sexually transmitted infections among people identifying as 'coloured', set against the country's history of racial classification.
指出资料收集缺乏规划会浪费有限资源，并概述尽量减少监测危害的策略，如只收集最少的数据、及早建立信任和保护数据。随后开始一个来自南部非洲某国的案例：诊所记录显示，自认“有色人种”者的性传播感染远多于其他人群，而该国有种族分类的历史。

Completes the case study, in which a community member of a research ethics committee objects to recording race in an STI survey because of existing stigma, while the investigator argues the data are essential. The summary section then stresses weighing physical harms against benefits and notes that individual interests may need to be balanced against the public good.
案例的结尾：研究伦理委员会的一位社区代表以现有污名为由，反对在性传播感染调查中记录种族，而研究者则认为这些数据必不可少。小结部分强调权衡身体危害与益处，并指出个人利益可能需要与公共利益相平衡。

Concludes the learning objective by noting that psychosocial harms and benefits are hard to quantify yet must be identified and weighed in context, using school closures during a pandemic as an example. It highlights involving affected communities in such decisions and ends with a references heading.
学习目标的结尾指出，社会心理方面的危害和利益难以量化，但必须结合具体情况加以识别和权衡，并以大流行期间关闭学校为例。文中强调让受影响社区参与此类决策，最后为参考文献标题。
A near-blank page with only a 'further reading' heading and translator credits.
几乎空白的一页，仅有“其他读物”标题和译校署名。

Opens learning objective 3.2 of the training manual, by Carl Coleman, on when public health surveillance needs explicit consent from individuals or communities, with a 60-minute session plan. Facilitator notes for the first discussion question explore whether a survey of multidrug-resistant tuberculosis is surveillance, research or both.
手册学习目标3.2开篇，作者Carl Coleman，主题是公共卫生监测何时需要个人或社区明确的知情同意，附60分钟课程时间表。针对第一个讨论问题的教员提示探讨一项耐多药结核病调查属于监测、研究还是两者兼有。

Gives facilitator guidance on the MDR-TB survey case, covering risks to patients such as stigma if identified, and arguments for and against seeking informed consent. It also lists what information might be disclosed and discusses whether patients may refuse testing.
就耐多药结核病调查案例为教员提供指导，涵盖患者面临的风险（如身份被确认后蒙受耻辱）以及赞成和反对征求知情同意的理由。本页还列出可能需要告知的信息，并讨论患者能否拒绝检测。

Advises consulting community and patient representatives about the survey design, then sets out the remaining steps of the group discussion and wrap-up. The background section defines informed consent and notes its basis in the Nuremberg Code, the Declaration of Helsinki and CIOMS guidelines.
建议就调查设计征求社区和患者代表的意见，随后列出小组讨论和总结的其余步骤。背景部分给出知情同意的定义，并指出其依据为纽伦堡法典、赫尔辛基宣言和CIOMS指南。

Explains the purposes of informed consent and the circumstances in which it may be waived or modified, such as routine blood tests or low-risk record-based research. It notes that CIOMS accepts waivers for some epidemiological studies and stresses that valid consent requires real understanding, which language and cultural barriers can complicate.
解释知情同意的目的，以及可予豁免或修改的情形，如常规血液检测或基于记录的低风险研究。文中指出CIOMS接受对某些流行病学研究的豁免，并强调有效同意需要真正理解，而语言和文化障碍可能使之复杂化。

States that non-consensual interventions should be a last resort with due process safeguards, and explains why informed consent usually plays a limited role in surveillance. It cautions that surveillance can still carry risks, such as stigma or harassment when identifiable information on HIV, MDR-TB or illegal behaviour is exposed.
指出非自愿干预措施只能作为最后手段，并须有正当程序保障，同时解释为何知情同意在监测中通常作用有限。文中提醒，监测仍可能带来风险，例如有关HIV、耐多药结核病或违法行为的可识别信息泄露后导致的污名或骚扰。

Argues that most people will join legitimate surveillance if well informed, and discusses community consultation as an alternative when individual consent is unsuitable. It covers the difficulty of identifying who can speak for a community and the need to involve communities early and be ready to change plans if they object.
论证若得到充分告知，大多数人愿意参与合法的公共卫生监测，并讨论在个人同意不适用时以社区咨询作为替代。文中涉及难以确定谁能代表社区的问题，以及需要及早让社区参与并在其反对时准备修改计划。

Gives the case study details: officials plan to test a random sample of tuberculosis patients for drug resistance using samples labelled only by date, so results cannot be returned to patients. The summary restates that consent is rarely part of routine surveillance but that informing people and seeking agreement shows respect and builds trust.
给出案例细节：官员计划对随机抽取的结核病患者进行耐药性检测，标本仅按日期标注，因此无法将结果反馈给患者。小结重申，常规监测很少涉及知情同意，但告知民众并征求同意体现尊重并有助于建立信任。
A near-blank page with only a 'further reading' heading and translator credits.
几乎空白的一页，仅有“其他读物”标题和译校署名。

Opens learning objective 3.3 of the training manual, by Ghaiath Hussein, on protecting privacy and confidentiality during emergencies, with a 90-minute session plan. The case study questions ask whether a survey team should share data with a village chief and how privacy could be breached.
手册学习目标3.3开篇，作者Ghaiath Hussein，主题是突发事件期间保护隐私和保密，附90分钟课程时间表。案例问题包括调查组是否应与村长共享数据，以及隐私可能如何被侵犯。

Lists practical safeguards for the survey case, such as explaining random sampling to the community leader, avoiding identifiers, coding respondents and transporting questionnaires in locked boxes. It ends the session plan and starts the background, noting that data collected in emergencies benefit communities but carry costs.
列出该调查案例的实际保护措施，如向社区领导人解释随机抽样、避免使用身份标识、对应答者编码以及用上锁的箱子运送问卷。随后结束课程安排并开始背景部分，指出突发事件中收集的数据有益于社区但也有代价。

Defines privacy as the right to be left alone and to control access to oneself, and confidentiality as the duty not to disclose information shared in trust. It explains why emergencies threaten both, citing less controlled settings, wider data sharing and improvised record-keeping.
将隐私定义为独处并控制他人接触自己的权利，将保密定义为不泄露基于信任而共享的信息的义务。文中解释突发事件为何对两者构成威胁，原因包括环境控制较差、数据共享范围更广以及临时性的记录保存。

Notes added risks from digital storage, unstable power and cloud or email sharing during emergencies. It then justifies the duty to protect privacy and confidentiality through the principles of beneficence and non-maleficence and respect for autonomy.
指出突发事件期间数字存储、电力不稳以及通过云端或电子邮件共享数据带来的额外风险。随后以受益和不伤害原则以及尊重自主权原则论证保护隐私和保密的义务。

Explains trustworthiness as a further reason to protect confidentiality, since fear of disclosure can push people towards unregistered providers and distort public health data. It introduces practical measures for protecting privacy, starting with collecting data away from onlookers.
将值得信任作为保护保密的另一理由，因为担心信息泄露会使人们转向未注册的服务提供者，并使公共卫生数据失真。随后介绍保护隐私的实际措施，首先是在旁观者视线之外收集数据。

Lists practical measures to protect confidentiality, such as limiting access to those who need to know, appointing record keepers, setting disclosure policies, collecting only relevant data and securing offices and records.
列出保护保密的实际措施，如仅限需要知情者接触资料、指定档案管理人员、制定信息披露政策、只收集相关数据以及确保办公室和档案安全。

Finishes the list of data security measures, including password control, encryption and protecting mobile devices. It then presents a case study in which a village leader in a remote area with tribal water disputes demands to see completed questionnaires from an NGO needs-assessment survey.
列完数据安全措施，包括密码控制、加密和保护移动设备。随后给出一个案例：在存在部落用水纠纷的偏远地区，一位村长要求查看某非政府组织需求评估调查已填写的问卷。

Summarises the learning objective, stating that respect for privacy and confidentiality must not be set aside in emergencies and that organizations should build these protections into their procedures, followed by reference and reading headings.
对本学习目标进行小结，指出在突发事件中不得搁置对隐私和保密的尊重，各组织应将这些保护措施纳入其工作程序，随后为参考文献和阅读材料标题。

Opens learning objective 3.4, by Carl Coleman, on protecting data and biological materials collected during public health surveillance, with a 60-minute session plan. Facilitator notes explain what households should be told before giving blood, including the sharing of positive samples with a European vaccine maker.
学习目标3.4开篇，作者Carl Coleman，主题是在公共卫生监测期间保护所收集的数据和生物学材料，附60分钟课程时间表。教员提示说明在采血前应告知家庭哪些信息，包括将阳性标本与一家欧洲疫苗生产商共享。

Gives facilitator notes on whether sample donors could be identified from date, time, place and behaviour data and the stigma this could cause. It also covers safeguards such as coarser location data and locked files, whether to return results, and the need for a material transfer agreement with the vaccine manufacturer.
教员提示讨论能否通过日期、时间、地点和行为数据识别标本提供者，以及由此可能导致的污名。本页还涉及保护措施（如使用更粗略的地点数据和上锁保存文件）、是否反馈结果，以及与疫苗生产商签订材料转让协议的必要性。

Completes the session steps and begins the background on biological samples collected in emergencies, describing uses such as identifying exposure, measuring drug resistance and developing vaccines. It notes ethical concerns that sampling can feel intrusive and that results may expose individuals to stigma or discrimination.
完成课程步骤并开始介绍突发事件中采集生物学标本的背景，说明其用途，如确定暴露情况、测定耐药性和研发疫苗。文中指出伦理方面的担忧：采样可能令人感到受侵扰，结果可能使个人遭受污名或歧视。

Discusses the risk of exploitation when samples are used to develop products that the source communities cannot afford, citing Indonesia's 2007 decision to stop sharing avian influenza samples with WHO and the 2011 virus-sharing framework. It then recommends prospective review by an independent ethics committee to decide on consent and limits on identifiable data.
讨论当标本被用于开发提供标本的社区无力负担的产品时可能产生的剥削风险，并举出印度尼西亚2007年停止向世界卫生组织共享禽流感标本以及2011年病毒共享框架的例子。随后建议由独立的伦理委员会进行前瞻性审查，以决定是否需要知情同意以及对可识别数据的限制。

Lists questions for deciding whether consent is needed for collecting biological samples and what donors should be told, such as purpose, storage, access, return of results and future uses. It explains that leaving out names does not guarantee anonymity, especially in very small groups or communities.
列出判断收集生物学标本是否需要知情同意以及应向提供者告知哪些内容的问题，如目的、保存、获取、结果反馈和今后的用途。并说明不记录姓名并不能保证匿名，在规模很小的群体或社区中尤其如此。

Discusses using existing samples for new purposes, recommending fresh authorization, community notification or removal of identifiers when the new use goes beyond the original consent. It also calls for fair benefit sharing, including returning results to local officials and offering resulting products at affordable prices.
讨论将现有标本用于新目的的问题，建议在新用途超出原先知情同意范围时重新获得授权、通知社区或去除身份标识。还呼吁公平分享惠益，包括将结果反馈给当地官员，并以可负担的价格提供由此开发的产品。

Describes the case study in which a government plans door-to-door blood sampling and brief questionnaires in villages with cases of a new disease, without names or return of results, and with positive samples sent to a European vaccine maker. The summary restates the ethical issues of intrusiveness, stigma and exploitation in collecting biological samples.
介绍案例研究：某国政府计划在出现一种新疾病病例的村庄挨家挨户采集血样并进行简短问卷调查，不记录姓名也不反馈结果，阳性标本则送往一家欧洲疫苗生产商。小结重申了收集生物学标本中的侵扰性、耻辱和剥削等伦理问题。

Opens learning objective 3.5, by Michael J. Selgelid, on cases where the public interest may override individual autonomy during surveillance, with a 60-minute session plan. It sets out the steps for small-group discussion and reporting back.
学习目标3.5开篇，作者Michael J. Selgelid，讨论在公共卫生监测期间公共利益可能压倒个人自主权的情况，附60分钟课程时间表。列出了小组讨论和汇报的步骤。

Explains that public health measures such as surveillance, notification, compulsory testing or treatment, isolation and quarantine each interfere with basic rights and ultimately with autonomy. It sets out why autonomy matters ethically, citing Mill and others, and why paternalism is generally viewed as problematic, before raising the question of when overriding it is justified.
说明监测、报告、强制检测或治疗、隔离和检疫等公共卫生措施都会干预基本权利，最终干预自主权。阐述自主权在伦理上为何重要（引用密尔等人的观点），以及家长主义为何通常被视为有问题，进而提出何时可以正当地压倒自主权的问题。

Asks how great a threat to society must be to justify overriding autonomy, contrasting minor infections with epidemics like SARS, H1N1 influenza and Ebola where isolation and quarantine are used. It also raises whether people exposed to disease have a moral duty to accept quarantine voluntarily.
追问对社会的威胁要多大才足以压倒自主权，将轻微感染与采用隔离和检疫措施的SARS、H1N1流感和埃博拉等流行病加以对比。还提出接触疾病的人是否负有自愿接受检疫的道德义务。

Discusses coercive measures that also benefit the individual, such as compulsory treatment or vaccination in an epidemic. It then introduces the case of John Jones, diagnosed with a possibly new, highly virulent extensively drug-resistant tuberculosis strain, whom public health authorities decide to isolate but cannot reach.
讨论同时也有利于个人的强制性措施，例如流行期间的强制治疗或接种疫苗。随后介绍John Jones的案例：他被诊断感染一种可能是新型、毒力很强的广泛耐药结核菌株，公共卫生当局决定对其实施隔离却联系不上他。

Lists discussion questions on whether to publish John Jones's name and photograph, alternative approaches, the relevance of his own conduct, transmission thresholds that might justify publicity and how long compulsory isolation would be ethical. The summary states that autonomy is important but not absolute and must be weighed against public health.
列出讨论问题：是否公布John Jones的姓名和照片、有哪些替代办法、他本人行为的相关性、何种传播风险程度可以使公开合理，以及强制隔离多长时间才合乎伦理。小结指出自主权很重要但并非绝对，必须与公共卫生相权衡。

The divider page for core competency 4 of the training manual, on identifying conflicts between the public good and individual autonomy in emergency research and clinical trials, with a photo credit of a Haiti hospital after the 2010 earthquake.
培训手册核心能力4的分隔页，主题是在应急响应期间的研究和临床试验中识别公共利益与个体自主权之间的冲突，附有2010年地震后海地一所医院的照片来源说明。

Introduces core competency 4, noting that research is part of emergency response but can cause harm as well as benefit. It lists four learning objectives on harms and benefits of research, ethical theories and frameworks, waiving consent as in intensive care research, and improving consent in traditional or low-resource settings.
介绍核心能力4，指出研究是应急响应的组成部分，但既能带来益处也可能造成伤害。列出四个学习目标：研究的危害与益处、伦理理论和框架、如重症监护研究中那样豁免知情同意，以及在传统社区或资源匮乏环境中改进知情同意。

Opens learning objective 4.1, by Lisa Schwartz, on the potential harms and benefits of research during emergencies for individuals and communities, with a 60-minute session plan. Groups split to list harms and benefits, and facilitators may show short videos on the 1918 influenza pandemic.
学习目标4.1开篇，作者Lisa Schwartz，内容是突发事件期间研究对个体和社区的潜在危害与益处，附60分钟课程时间表。各小组分头列举危害和益处，教员还可以播放关于1918年流感大流行的短视频。

Continues the session plan with discussion of how to handle conflicts between ethical principles, stressing that open debate matters more than full agreement. Groups then analyse three quotations on the tension between population health and individual rights.
课程安排继续讨论如何处理伦理原则之间的冲突，强调公开讨论比完全达成一致更重要。随后各小组分析三段反映人群健康与个人权利之间张力的引文。

Lists case-study questions on expected benefits, who bears risks and how to reduce them, then closes the session plan. The background notes that research during emergencies, as in identifying the SARS virus, can improve outcomes but has also caused serious harm, raising ethical issues at every stage.
列出关于预期益处、由谁承担风险以及如何降低风险的案例研究问题，然后结束课程安排。背景部分指出，突发事件期间的研究（如鉴定SARS病毒）能够改善结局，但也曾造成严重伤害，在每个阶段都会引发伦理问题。

Identifies fair distribution of research benefits and burdens as the core ethical issue, especially when people are more vulnerable during emergencies. It raises questions about who sets research agendas, how resources are allocated and how to prevent exploitation, while recalling the moral duty to do beneficial research.
指出研究益处和负担的公平分配是核心伦理问题，尤其是在人们在突发事件期间更加脆弱的情况下。提出由谁制定研究议程、如何分配资源以及如何防止剥削等问题，同时重申开展有益研究的道德义务。

Notes the need for creative yet sound study designs to speed access to treatments and the value of research for understanding causes, transmission and treatment. It then lists potential harms of emergency research, including serious adverse effects and inefficient diversion of scarce resources from care.
指出需要富有创意而又严谨的研究设计来加快获得治疗，以及研究对了解病因、传播和治疗的价值。随后列举突发事件期间研究的潜在危害，包括严重不良反应以及把稀缺资源从医疗照护中低效地挪用。

Discusses when favouring the greater public good over individual interests may be fair and argues trade-offs should be transparent with care for those harmed. It warns against exposing participants to unnecessary risk through poor study design and introduces ethical concepts for emergency research.
讨论在什么情况下优先考虑更大的公共利益而非个人利益可能是公平的，主张权衡取舍应当透明，并照顾受到伤害的人。告诫不要因研究设计不佳而使参与者承受不必要的风险，并引出与突发事件期间研究有关的伦理概念。

Lists ethical concepts relevant to emergency research, such as fair process, global and social justice, reciprocity, responsibility, solidarity and transparency. It then presents case studies of the Trovan trial in Nigeria and the 2003 SARS outbreak, tracing how infection spread from a Hong Kong hotel to Toronto.
列出与突发事件期间研究相关的伦理概念，如公平程序、全球与社会公正、互惠、责任、团结和透明。随后介绍尼日利亚Trovan试验和2003年SARS暴发的案例，追溯感染如何从香港一家酒店传到多伦多。

Describes the impact of SARS on Toronto, where health workers made up a large share of cases and the outbreak led to quarantines, school closure and hospital disruption. It notes cancelled services, unmeasured indirect harms and controversy over surveillance, research and access to patient data under privacy laws.
描述SARS对多伦多的影响：卫生工作者在病例中占很大比例，疫情导致检疫、学校关闭和医院运转受到干扰。还提到服务被取消、间接危害未被衡量，以及在隐私法律下围绕监测、研究和获取病人资料的争议。

Concludes that ethical principles for emergency research are useful but must be negotiated, since favouring one means compromising others. It cautions that 'greater good' arguments must consider who bears the losses and how to reduce risk, pointing to informed consent as a key protection.
总结指出，突发事件期间研究的伦理原则有用，但需要协商，因为偏重一项原则就意味着在其他原则上让步。提醒“更大利益”的论点必须考虑由谁承担损失以及如何降低风险，并指出知情同意是一项关键保护。

Opens learning objective 4.2, by Michael J. Selgelid, on ethical theories and frameworks for research in emergencies, with a slide-based 60-minute session plan. Facilitators present the main ethical frameworks and a pluralistic approach, then discuss each principle's justification and legitimacy.
学习目标4.2开篇，作者Michael J. Selgelid，内容是突发事件期间研究的伦理理论和框架，附基于幻灯片的60分钟课程时间表。教员介绍主要伦理框架和多元化方法，然后讨论每项原则的理由和正当性。

Outlines utilitarian, egalitarian, libertarian and rights-based theories and how they emphasise different values. It explains that these values can conflict, giving examples such as collecting blood or data without consent to benefit many.
概述功利主义、平等主义、自由意志主义和基于权利的理论，以及它们各自强调的价值。说明这些价值可能相互冲突，并举例如为使多数人受益而未经同意采集血液或数据。

Notes that existing public health ethics frameworks can justify liberty-restricting measures in epidemics and can also guide emergency research. It then explains the principles of evidence and least restrictive means, with prompts on applying each to research.
指出现有的公共卫生伦理框架可以为流行病期间限制自由的措施提供依据，也可用于指导突发事件期间的研究。随后解释证据原则和最少限制手段原则，并附有如何将每项原则用于研究的提示。

Explains the principles of proportionality, which balances the degree of intrusion against the expected public health benefit, and equity, which requires non-discriminatory measures and extra protection for disadvantaged groups. Facilitator prompts relate both to research in emergencies.
解释相称性原则（在侵扰程度与预期公共卫生效益之间取得平衡）和公平原则（要求措施不具歧视性，并对弱势群体给予额外保护）。教员提示将两者与突发事件期间的研究联系起来。

Covers the remaining principles of providing basic needs to those whose liberty is restricted, reciprocity through compensating people harmed for the public good, and due legal process. Each comes with prompts on applying it to emergency research.
介绍其余原则：为自由受到限制的人提供基本需要、通过补偿为公共利益而受损者体现互惠，以及正当法律程序。每项原则都附有将其应用于突发事件期间研究的提示。

Explains the principle of democracy and transparency as key to public trust and asks whether placebo-controlled Ebola trials depend on community acceptance. The summary notes that the four ethical theories rank values differently and that public health ethics principles can guide emergency research but need further thought.
解释民主与透明原则是获得公众信任的关键，并提问埃博拉安慰剂对照试验是否取决于社区的接受。小结指出，四种伦理理论对价值的排序不同，公共卫生伦理原则可以指导突发事件期间的研究，但仍需进一步思考。

Opens learning objective 4.3, by Lisa Schwartz, on current standards for waiving informed consent in critical care research and whether they apply in emergencies, with a 75-minute session plan. Groups debate whether research without consent should ever be allowed before discussing accepted waiver standards.
学习目标4.3开篇，作者Lisa Schwartz，内容是重症监护研究中豁免知情同意的现行规范及其是否适用于突发事件，附75分钟课程时间表。各小组先辩论是否应允许未经同意开展研究，然后讨论公认的豁免标准。

Lists discussion questions on whether the Trovan and SARS cases meet minimal-risk conditions for waiving consent. Facilitator notes argue the Trovan trial did not meet accepted waiver standards despite proxy parental consent under pressure, while SARS research on health records might qualify under Canadian research council minimal-risk criteria.
列出讨论问题：Trovan和SARS案例是否符合豁免知情同意的最低风险条件。教员说明认为，尽管有在压力下取得的家长代理同意，Trovan试验仍不符合公认的豁免标准；而利用健康记录开展的SARS研究按照加拿大研究理事会的最低风险标准可能符合条件。

Notes that in critical care, emergency treatment of unconscious patients without consent is legally accepted, and some frameworks extend waivers to low-risk research that could not be done otherwise. It gives examples of research that may need a waiver, such as retrospective data collection and large observational studies.
指出在重症监护中，未经同意对失去意识的病人进行紧急治疗在法律上是被接受的，一些框架还将豁免扩展到不豁免就无法开展的低风险研究。举例说明可能需要豁免的研究，如回顾性数据收集和大型观察性研究。

Quotes Canadian research ethics provisions setting out when a research ethics board may approve minimal-risk research without consent, such as low risk, no adverse effect on participants and impracticability. It then asks how these criteria apply in emergencies, where interventions may not be minimal risk.
引用加拿大研究伦理规定，说明研究伦理委员会在何种条件下可以批准未经同意的最低风险研究，如风险低、对参与者无不良影响以及取得同意不可行。随后提问这些标准如何适用于干预措施可能并非最低风险的突发事件。

Concludes that consent waivers in emergencies may be acceptable if benefits are sufficient, the research cannot be done otherwise and consent is sought later, with decisions by an independent ethics committee. The summary affirms that individual consent remains the standard and any exception must meet strict criteria.
总结指出，在突发事件中，如果益处足够、研究无法以其他方式进行且事后补取同意，并由独立伦理委员会作出决定，豁免知情同意可能是可以接受的。小结重申个人知情同意仍是标准，任何例外都必须符合严格标准。

Opens learning objective 4.4, by Caroline Clarinval, on improving informed consent for emergency research in traditional communities and low-resource settings, with a 90-minute session plan. Learners read the Trovan case and related news items and discuss the ethical challenges of research in such settings.
学习目标4.4开篇，作者Caroline Clarinval，内容是在传统社区和资源匮乏环境中改进突发事件期间研究的知情同意，附90分钟课程时间表。学员阅读Trovan案例和相关新闻报道，讨论在此类环境中开展研究的伦理挑战。

Gives facilitator notes on barriers to consent in traditional and low-resource settings, such as language, culture and limited schooling, and the risk of coercion and exploitation. It explains how the Trovan trial failed on disclosure and consent and how sponsors could have avoided the scandal through best practice and community engagement.
教员说明介绍传统社区和资源匮乏环境中知情同意的障碍，如语言、文化和受教育程度有限，以及胁迫和剥削的风险。解释Trovan试验在信息披露和知情同意方面的失败，以及申办方本可如何通过最佳做法和社区参与避免这一丑闻。

Notes that existing consent guidelines give little guidance for vulnerable people in emergencies, who may face an added layer of vulnerability. It lists external factors affecting voluntary participation, such as therapeutic misconception, money, access to drugs and power imbalances, and links many so-called cultural responses to poverty and instability.
指出现有的知情同意指南对突发事件中的脆弱人群指导很少，他们可能面临又一层脆弱性。列出影响自愿参与的外部因素，如治疗误解、金钱、获得药物的机会和权力不平衡，并将许多所谓的文化反应归因于贫困和不稳定。

Explains that people without health coverage or social safety nets are more likely to accept research risks without benefit, so researchers should consider why people take part. It notes that standard consent procedures may be especially hard to apply in emergencies, given gaps in knowledge and status between local people and outside research teams.
说明没有医疗保障或社会安全网的人更可能接受没有益处的研究风险，因此研究者应考虑人们参与的原因。指出由于当地人与外来研究团队之间在知识和地位上的差距，标准的知情同意程序在突发事件中可能尤其难以实施。

Discusses community consultation in traditional settings, noting that leaders may exclude some people and that communities must be involved early enough to shape research design. It stresses respecting local customs through preparatory meetings while ensuring community permission never replaces individual consent.
讨论传统社区中的社区协商，指出领导者可能把一些人排除在外，社区必须足够早地参与才能影响研究设计。强调通过筹备会议尊重当地习俗，同时确保社区许可绝不能取代个人知情同意。

Lists practices for consent in traditional communities, such as involving the community in protocols, avoiding coercion, respecting refusals and considering community structures. It then turns to low-resource settings, urging researchers and aid agencies to meet basic needs and health care access whether or not people take part.
列出传统社区中取得知情同意的做法，如让社区参与制定方案、避免胁迫、尊重拒绝以及考虑社区结构。随后转向资源匮乏环境，敦促研究者和援助机构无论人们是否参加研究都要满足其基本需要和获得卫生保健的需求。

Cites the Trovan trial in Nigeria as the case study and summarises that cultural differences, power and knowledge gaps, poverty and lack of health coverage increase vulnerability in emergencies. It states researchers must weigh benefits to future patients against participants' interests, avoid further harm and share benefits.
以尼日利亚Trovan试验作为案例研究，小结指出文化差异、权力和知识差距、贫困以及缺乏医疗保障会加重突发事件中的脆弱性。指出研究者必须权衡对未来病人的益处与参与者的利益，避免造成进一步伤害并分享惠益。
Closes the learning objective by suggesting consent be sought before emergencies where possible and that researchers work with other agencies to meet basic needs, followed by a references heading.
在学习目标结尾建议尽可能在突发事件发生前就征得同意，并建议研究者与其他机构合作满足基本需要，随后是参考文献标题。
A near-blank page with only a 'further reading' heading and translator credits.
几乎空白的一页，只有“其他读物”标题和译校者署名。
The divider page for core competency 5 of the training manual, on the relationship between surveillance or emergency research and publication ethics.
培训手册核心能力5的分隔页，主题是公共卫生监测或突发事件期间研究与出版伦理之间的关系。

Introduces core competency 5, noting a moral duty to share findings that protect the public in emergencies. It lists learning objectives on when routine surveillance or clinical data may be published, publication bias and ethical duties around ownership of scientific data.
介绍核心能力5，指出在突发事件中负有分享保护公众的研究发现的道德义务。列出的学习目标涉及常规监测或临床数据何时可以发表、发表偏倚，以及围绕科学数据所有权的伦理义务。

Opens learning objective 5.1, by Philippe Calain, on conditions for publishing data from surveillance or routine clinical care, with a 75-minute session plan. Learners read a published article as if it were a draft and role-play whether retrospective ethical approval should be required before publication.
学习目标5.1开篇，作者Philippe Calain，内容是发表来自监测或常规临床治疗的数据的条件，附75分钟课程时间表。学员把一篇已发表的文章当作草稿阅读，并通过角色扮演讨论发表前是否应补办伦理审批。

Lists issues for discussion, such as patients not being told they were part of a trial and the lack of prior ethics review. The background explains the duty to share useful findings quickly and introduces an 'ethical calculus' for weighing the value of publishing operational data collected without consent or review.
列出讨论议题，如病人未被告知自己参加了试验以及缺乏事先的伦理审查。背景部分解释了迅速分享有用发现的义务，并引入一种“伦理演算”来权衡发表未经同意或审查而收集的业务数据的价值。

Sets out the criteria for ethical review of publishing routinely collected data, beginning with the type of activity, since operational research may be exempt from standard review but is hard to define. It notes differing definitions of operational research and refers to a figure on research to improve health systems.
提出对发表常规收集数据进行伦理审查的标准，首先是活动类型：业务研究可能免于标准审查，但难以界定。指出业务研究的定义各不相同，并提到一张关于改进卫生系统的研究的图。

Explains further criteria for publishing surveillance or clinical data, including relevance of the data, scientific validity and clear acknowledgement of limitations. It also covers confidentiality, requiring removal of identifiers, and minimising risks such as stigma to communities.
解释发表监测或临床数据的其他标准，包括数据的相关性、科学有效性以及明确说明局限性。还涉及保密，要求去除身份标识，并尽量减少对社区的耻辱等风险。

Calls for informing and seeking agreement from those involved, collaborating with local stakeholders before publication and making results accessible to patients and communities. The summary describes publication of such data as a grey area and recommends weighing harms against benefits using the listed criteria.
呼吁告知相关人员并征得其同意，在发表前与当地利益相关方合作，并让病人和社区能够获取结果。小结将此类数据的发表描述为灰色地带，建议依据所列标准权衡危害与益处。
A near-blank page with only a 'further reading' heading and translator credits.
几乎空白的一页，只有“其他读物”标题和译校者署名。

Opens learning objective 5.2, by Maxwell J. Smith, on publication bias and its effect on emergency response, with a 90-minute session plan. Learners read commentaries by Godlee and Loder and by Cohen, watch a video about the antiviral oseltamivir (Tamiflu) and discuss a case study.
学习目标5.2开篇，作者Maxwell J. Smith，内容是发表偏倚及其对突发事件应对的影响，附90分钟课程时间表。学员阅读Godlee和Loder以及Cohen撰写的评论，观看有关抗病毒药物奥司他韦（达菲）的视频，并讨论一个案例研究。

Lists the discussion questions on whether the case shows publication bias, how to prevent it and how it affects emergency response. The background explains that emergency decisions rely on research evidence and that what gets published can itself be biased.
列出讨论问题：该案例是否体现了发表偏倚、如何预防，以及它如何影响突发事件应对。背景部分说明突发事件中的决策依赖研究证据，而哪些研究得以发表本身就可能存在偏倚。

Defines publication bias and notes that only 21 of 73 registered H1N1 vaccine trials were published two years after the pandemic strain appeared. It explains that bias distorts the evidence used in reviews and meta-analyses, leaving decision-makers to act on incomplete information.
界定发表偏倚，并指出在大流行毒株出现两年后，73项已注册的H1N1疫苗试验中只有21项发表。解释偏倚会扭曲系统综述和荟萃分析所用的证据，使决策者只能依据不完整的信息行事。

Describes positive-results bias, which can overstate the effectiveness of measures like antiviral prophylaxis and divert scarce resources, and may delay publication of negative findings until after an emergency. It then introduces 'hot stuff' and 'lack of interest' biases tied to topical subjects.
描述阳性结果偏倚：它可能夸大抗病毒药物预防等措施的效果、挪用稀缺资源，并可能把阴性结果的发表推迟到突发事件结束之后。随后介绍与热门话题相关的“热点”偏倚和“缺乏兴趣”偏倚。

Explains lack-of-interest bias, where research begun during brief emergencies goes unpublished as attention fades or journals tire of a topic. It also describes how career pressure to publish in high-impact journals can delay sharing of time-sensitive results.
解释缺乏兴趣偏倚：在短暂的突发事件期间开始的研究，随着关注消退或期刊对该话题失去兴趣而未能发表。还描述了在高影响力期刊发表论文的职业压力如何拖延时效性强的结果的分享。

Lists further biases, such as funding or sponsorship bias, language bias and citation bias, and notes that identifying them is a challenge. It then outlines remedies including open access to data and more transparent, accountable peer review.
列出其他偏倚，如资金或赞助偏倚、语言偏倚和引用偏倚，并指出识别这些偏倚是一项挑战。随后概述补救办法，包括数据开放获取以及更透明、更负责任的同行评议。

Presents the case of a 2003 Roche-sponsored analysis reporting that oseltamivir (Tamiflu) reduced influenza complications and hospital admissions, based on ten trials of which only two were published. It notes a later Cochrane review found insufficient evidence without the unpublished data, although policy-makers had used the evidence to justify stockpiling, and poses discussion questions.
介绍案例：2003年由罗氏公司赞助的一项分析报告称奥司他韦（达菲）可减少流感并发症和住院，所依据的10项试验中只有2项已发表。指出后来的一份Cochrane综述认为，如果没有未发表的数据，证据就不充分，而决策者曾用这些证据为储备药物提供理由；并提出讨论问题。

Continues the discussion questions, including how to decide when evidence may be biased and whether reviewers or editors should see underlying data. The summary states that publication bias distorts the evidence base and can lead to over- or underestimating the effects of public health measures in emergencies.
继续列出讨论问题，包括如何判断证据何时可能有偏倚，以及审稿人或编辑是否应看到原始数据。小结指出，发表偏倚会扭曲证据基础，并可能导致高估或低估突发事件中公共卫生措施的效果。

Concludes that reducing publication bias requires examining stakeholders' interests, improving data access, trial registration and evidence synthesis, and cooperation among publishers, researchers and sponsors to put public health first.
总结指出，减少发表偏倚需要审视利益相关方的利益，改进数据获取、试验注册和证据综合，并需要出版者、研究者和申办方合作，把公共卫生放在首位。
A near-blank page with only translator credits.
几乎空白的一页，只有译校者署名。

Opens learning objective 5.3, by Maxwell J. Smith, on ethical obligations of researchers, public health staff and publishers regarding ownership of scientific data, with a 120-minute session plan. Learners read set papers, watch a Tamiflu video and split into two groups to debate strict data control versus open sharing.
学习目标5.3开篇，作者Maxwell J. Smith，内容是研究者、公共卫生人员和出版者在科学数据所有权方面的伦理义务，附120分钟课程时间表。学员阅读指定文章，观看一段关于达菲的视频，并分成两组辩论严格控制数据与开放共享。

Continues the session plan, asking about the conflict between data ownership and the public interest in the Tamiflu case. It lists questions on how far researchers, institutions, sponsors, publishers, clinicians and the public should be able to access data and what responsibilities each has.
课程安排继续，提问达菲案例中数据所有权与公共利益之间的冲突。列出问题：研究者、机构、申办方、出版者、临床医生和公众应在多大程度上能够获取数据，以及各自承担哪些责任。

Asks how far regulators and public health agencies should be held responsible for decisions made without access to all data, and closes the session plan. The background notes that the availability of research data is central to public health practice and that restrictive access policies limit its use.
提问监管机构和公共卫生机构在无法获得全部数据的情况下所作的决定应承担多大责任，并结束课程安排。背景部分指出，研究数据的可得性是公共卫生实践的核心，限制性的获取政策会限制数据的使用。

Explains that lack of data access can weaken emergency response, citing gaps in data-sharing agreements during SARS in Canada in 2003 and confusion over vaccine data during the 2009–2010 H1N1 pandemic. It focuses the unit on the ethical duties of researchers, public health staff and publishers in managing and sharing data.
说明无法获取数据会削弱应急响应，举出2003年加拿大SARS期间数据共享协议的缺口以及2009—2010年H1N1大流行期间疫苗数据的混乱。本单元聚焦研究者、公共卫生人员和出版者在管理和共享数据方面的伦理义务。

Sets out arguments for data sharing, noting that restricting access to data needed for diagnostics, vaccines and other measures can limit their social value. It contrasts limited data sharing in public health with fields such as genomics and notes that career incentives can discourage timely release of results.
提出支持数据共享的理由，指出限制获取诊断、疫苗等措施所需的数据会削弱其社会价值。将公共卫生领域有限的数据共享与基因组学等领域相对比，并指出职业激励可能妨碍及时公布结果。

Notes that commercially sponsored research may treat data as intellectual property requiring permission or payment, which complicates ethical policies on data sharing. It then presents the oseltamivir (Tamiflu) case, in which a Roche-sponsored analysis relied on mostly unpublished trials that a later Cochrane review could not verify.
指出商业赞助的研究可能把数据视为知识产权，需要许可或付费，这使数据共享的伦理政策更加复杂。随后介绍奥司他韦（达菲）案例：罗氏赞助的分析主要依据未发表的试验，后来的Cochrane综述无法加以核实。

Gives facilitator notes on discussion questions about making public health decisions without all data, whether research ethics committees should ensure findings are disseminated, and whether unpublished research has scientific and social value. It also raises whether duties differ for raw data and other types of data.
教员说明涉及以下讨论问题：在没有全部数据的情况下作出公共卫生决定、研究伦理委员会是否应确保研究结果得到传播，以及未发表的研究是否具有科学和社会价值。还提出对原始数据和其他类型数据的义务是否不同。

Asks who should be responsible for data-sharing agreements, such as funders, sponsors, universities or researchers. The summary argues that restricted data undermine evidence-based emergency decisions and that data producers and publishers have an ethical duty to share data transparently despite career and commercial pressures.
提问应由谁负责数据共享协议，如资助者、申办方、大学或研究者。小结认为，受限的数据会削弱基于证据的应急决策，数据生产者和出版者尽管面临职业和商业压力，仍负有透明共享数据的伦理义务。
A near-blank page with only a 'further reading' heading and translator credits.
几乎空白的一页，只有“其他读物”标题和译校者署名。
The section title page for the patient care part of the training manual.
培训手册中病人照护部分的标题页。

The divider page for core competency 6 of the training manual, on ethical criteria for triage, resource allocation and standards of care during emergency response, with a photo credit from the 2010 Haiti earthquake.
培训手册核心能力6的分隔页，主题是应急响应期间检伤分类、资源分配和医疗标准的伦理标准，附有2010年海地地震的照片来源说明。

Introduces core competency 6, noting that triage and rationing are central to crisis response. It lists learning objectives on ethical frameworks for triage and allocation, altered standards of care, sharing benefits with communities in surveillance, and fair access to unproven treatments during research.
介绍核心能力6，指出检伤分类和配给是危机应对的核心。列出的学习目标涉及检伤分类和资源分配的伦理框架、改变后的医疗标准、在监测中与社区分享惠益，以及研究期间公平获得未经证实的治疗。

Opens learning objective 6.1, by A.M. Viens, on ethical frameworks and criteria for triage and resource allocation in emergencies, with a 90-minute session plan. Small groups discuss questions on which resources must be allocated, who should make triage decisions and conflicts between public and individual interests.
学习目标6.1开篇，作者A.M. Viens，内容是突发事件中检伤分类和资源分配的伦理框架和标准，附90分钟课程时间表。小组讨论哪些资源必须分配、应由谁作检伤分类决定，以及公共利益与个人利益之间的冲突。

Lists further questions on age discrimination, quality of life and whether ideas of fairness change in emergencies, and assigns readings by Smith and Viens, Melnychuk and Kenny, and Persad and colleagues. Facilitators then explain how ethical principles can be used to build triage frameworks.
列出关于年龄歧视、生活质量以及公平观念在突发事件中是否改变的进一步问题，并指定Smith和Viens、Melnychuk和Kenny以及Persad等人的阅读材料。随后教员说明如何利用伦理原则构建检伤分类框架。

Poses questions on resolving conflicts between equity and saving the most lives, ensuring triage processes are fair, and whether different principles can justify different allocation strategies. The background notes that limited time and resources force health workers to decide who receives which care.
提出问题：如何解决公平与挽救最多生命之间的冲突、如何确保检伤分类过程公平，以及不同原则能否为不同的分配策略提供依据。背景部分指出，有限的时间和资源迫使卫生工作者决定谁接受何种照护。

Distinguishes triage from rationing, using the example of a yearly quota of hip replacements, and stresses that the two should not be confused. It explains that the unit focuses on triage criteria and ethical principles that together form a framework for setting priorities in emergencies.
以每年髋关节置换配额为例区分检伤分类与配给，强调两者不应混淆。说明本单元重点是检伤分类标准和伦理原则，两者共同构成突发事件中确定优先次序的框架。

Notes that triage takes place at different levels, from the disaster scene to hospitals and public health agencies, each with its own considerations. It then describes triage criteria, including saving the most lives, first come first served and protecting the most vulnerable.
指出检伤分类在不同层面进行，从灾害现场到医院和公共卫生机构，各有其考虑。随后介绍检伤分类标准，包括挽救最多生命、先到先得以及保护最脆弱者。

Describes further triage criteria, including equal access or a lottery, and prioritising those most important to society, such as first responders. It notes that non-resource measures like early discharge or cancelling elective procedures also raise ethical issues, and begins to describe substantive and procedural ethical principles.
介绍更多检伤分类标准，包括平等获得或抽签，以及优先照顾对社会最重要的人，如第一响应者。指出提前出院或取消择期手术等非资源性措施也会引发伦理问题，并开始介绍实质性和程序性伦理原则。
Lists substantive ethical principles for triage, including individual liberty, protecting the public from harm, proportionality, privacy, the duty to provide care and reciprocity.
列出检伤分类的实质性伦理原则，包括个人自由、保护公众免受伤害、相称性、隐私、提供照护的义务和互惠。
Describes the principles of solidarity and stewardship and five procedural values: reasonableness, openness and transparency, inclusiveness, responsiveness and accountability.
介绍团结和管理职责原则，以及五项程序性价值：合理性、公开透明、包容性、响应性和问责。

Concludes that triage decisions should follow ethical principles while considering the quantity of resources, the ability to obtain more and available staff, and that the ethical justification for any triage scheme must be explicit, followed by reference headings.
总结指出，检伤分类决定应遵循伦理原则，同时考虑资源数量、获取更多资源的能力和可用人员，任何检伤分类方案的伦理依据都必须明确，其后是参考文献标题。
A near-blank page with only translator credits.
几乎空白的一页，只有译校者署名。

Opens learning objective 6.2, by Philippe Calain and Renaud F. Boulanger, on how standards of care may change in emergencies, with a 90-minute session plan. Learners read part of an article by Fink, watch a video about Dr Anna Pou and discuss her ethical dilemma and moral versus legal guilt.
学习目标6.2开篇，作者Philippe Calain和Renaud F. Boulanger，内容是医疗标准在突发事件中可能如何改变，附90分钟课程时间表。学员阅读Fink文章的一部分，观看关于Anna Pou医生的视频，讨论她的伦理困境以及道德罪责与法律罪责的区别。

Continues the session plan with group work on a scenario about what Dr Smith should do and a review of stakeholder views from Levin and colleagues. The background defines standard of care as peer-agreed appropriate treatment with legal and ethical implications and asks whether adjusting it to circumstances is acceptable.
课程安排继续：小组讨论Smith医生应如何做的情景，并回顾Levin等人收集的利益相关方意见。背景部分将医疗标准定义为同行公认的适当治疗，具有法律和伦理含义，并提问根据情况调整医疗标准是否可以接受。

Argues that research must not be carried out at the cost of lower standards of care and that diverting scarce resources to research or doing opportunistic research is unethical. It introduces the two case studies, in which Dr Pou changed the standard of care on her own and was prosecuted, while Dr Smith resisted a new standard imposed by hospital managers.
主张研究不得以降低医疗标准为代价，把稀缺资源挪用于研究或开展机会主义研究是不道德的。介绍两个案例研究：Pou医生自行改变了医疗标准并遭到起诉，而Smith医生则抵制医院管理者强加的新标准。

Describes factors that can change standards of care in emergencies, including staff and supply shortages, wider availability of unproven treatments and changing attitudes to risk. It also raises the question of what care control groups in emergency research should receive.
描述突发事件中可能改变医疗标准的因素，包括人员和物资短缺、未经证实的治疗更易获得以及对风险态度的变化。还提出突发事件期间研究中的对照组应接受何种照护的问题。

Notes that government funding decisions during an emergency can change the standard of care. It then presents case 1 on Dr Pou during Hurricane Katrina and case 2 on Dr Smith during an influenza pandemic in which surgery for cancer patients is postponed because hospitals are overwhelmed.
指出突发事件期间政府的资金决定可能改变医疗标准。随后介绍案例1：卡特里娜飓风期间的Pou医生；案例2：流感大流行期间的Smith医生，因医院不堪重负，癌症病人的手术被推迟。

Describes Dr Smith's dilemma over operating on a 36-year-old mother with ovarian cancer against hospital rules, weighing professional duty against institutional policy. A box reports deliberative sessions with Massachusetts residents and health workers, who valued patient advocacy but opposed breaking hospital policy and called for better system support.
描述Smith医生的困境：是否违反医院规定为一名患卵巢癌的36岁母亲做手术，在职业责任与机构政策之间权衡。一个专栏报告了与马萨诸塞州居民和卫生工作者举行的审议会议，他们重视为病人代言，但反对违反医院政策，并呼吁加强系统支持。
A near-empty page closing the learning objective with a fragment on expectations for control groups in health research, followed by reference and reading headings and translator credits.
几乎空白的一页，以关于卫生研究中对照组期望的片段结束本学习目标，其后是参考文献和读物标题以及译校者署名。

Opens learning objective 6.3, by Dónal O'Mathúna, on sharing benefits with communities in public health surveillance, with a 105-minute session plan. Learners reflect on UNESCO's Declaration on Bioethics and Human Rights, which warns against benefits becoming undue inducements, and discuss an article by Simm.
学习目标6.3开篇，作者Dónal O'Mathúna，内容是在公共卫生监测中与社区分享惠益，附105分钟课程时间表。学员思考联合国教科文组织《世界生物伦理与人权宣言》（其中告诫惠益不应成为不当引诱），并讨论Simm的一篇文章。

Lists case-study questions on whether Indonesia's decision to keep avian influenza samples was ethical, whether countries must share virus samples and whether vaccine makers must share benefits. The background notes that benefit sharing arose in the 1970s in response to common heritage ideas, genetic resources and globalized clinical research.
列出案例研究问题：印度尼西亚保留禽流感标本的决定是否合乎伦理、各国是否必须共享病毒标本，以及疫苗生产商是否必须分享惠益。背景部分指出，惠益分享概念产生于20世纪70年代，是对人类共同遗产观念、遗传资源和全球化临床研究的回应。

Explains concern that treating resources as common heritage could enable exploitation and biopiracy, such as removing medicinal plants from poor countries. It describes how the 1992 Convention on Biological Diversity defined benefit sharing as a matter of fairness and notes the spread of the idea into health research.
解释人们担心把资源视为共同遗产可能助长剥削和生物剽窃，例如从贫穷国家带走药用植物。介绍1992年《生物多样性公约》如何把惠益分享界定为公平问题，并指出这一理念扩展到卫生研究领域。

Quotes the UNESCO declaration's article on sharing benefits of research, especially with developing countries, and its warning against improper inducement. It then gives a definition of benefit sharing based on human genetic resources and begins to set out its moral justifications.
引用联合国教科文组织宣言中关于分享研究惠益（特别是与发展中国家分享）的条款及其对不当引诱的告诫。随后给出基于人类遗传资源的惠益分享定义，并开始阐述其道德理由。

Sets out moral arguments for benefit sharing based on property rights, the risks borne by research participants (reflected in the Declaration of Helsinki) and global justice. It then introduces benefit sharing in surveillance, noting WHO laboratories have collected virus samples for decades and the role of the International Health Regulations.
阐述惠益分享的道德论据，依据包括财产权、研究参与者承担的风险（体现在《赫尔辛基宣言》中）以及全球正义。随后介绍监测中的惠益分享，指出世界卫生组织的实验室几十年来一直收集病毒标本，并提到《国际卫生条例》的作用。

Describes the dispute over pandemic influenza vaccines, with some countries arguing virus sharing should earn them vaccine access and manufacturers arguing they cannot supply vaccines free. It cites WHO's 2011 Pandemic Influenza Preparedness Framework and begins the Indonesia case study.
描述围绕大流行性流感疫苗的争议：一些国家认为共享病毒应使其获得疫苗，而生产商则认为无法免费提供疫苗。引用世界卫生组织2011年《大流行性流感防范框架》，并开始介绍印度尼西亚案例研究。

Recounts Indonesia's 2007 refusal to send avian influenza samples to WHO collaborating centres, citing unaffordable vaccines and the concept of 'viral sovereignty' advanced by the health minister. It presents counterarguments that viruses cross borders and that pandemic risk outweighs such claims.
叙述印度尼西亚2007年拒绝向世界卫生组织合作中心送交禽流感标本，理由是疫苗价格难以负担以及卫生部长提出的“病毒主权”概念。并介绍反驳意见：病毒会跨越国界，大流行风险比此类主张更为重要。

Concludes that benefit sharing is ethically compelling but contested because of power imbalances and commercial pressures, and that legal instruments like the Convention on Biological Diversity may help distribute benefits more fairly, followed by a references heading.
总结指出，惠益分享在伦理上很有说服力，但由于权力不平衡和商业压力而存在争议，《生物多样性公约》等法律文书可能有助于更公平地分配惠益，其后是参考文献标题。

Opens learning objective 6.4, by Philippe Calain and Renaud F. Boulanger, on fair access to unproven treatments during emergency research, with a 60-minute session plan. Facilitator notes describe a case on post-exposure prophylaxis during an Ebola outbreak, highlighting the tension between rigorous trials and compassionate life-saving use.
学习目标6.4开篇，作者Philippe Calain和Renaud F. Boulanger，内容是突发事件期间研究中公平获得未经证实的治疗，附60分钟课程时间表。教员说明介绍了埃博拉暴发期间暴露后预防的案例，突出严格试验与出于同情的救命使用之间的张力。

Notes that a 2014 WHO panel judged it ethical to offer unproven Ebola interventions in the exceptional outbreak circumstances. Seven groups discuss questions on compassionate use, reciprocity for exposed scientists, equal access for African health workers and whether investigational drugs should be limited to trials.
指出2014年世界卫生组织专家小组认为，在暴发的特殊情况下提供未经证实的埃博拉干预措施是合乎伦理的。七个小组讨论以下问题：同情使用、对受暴露科学家的互惠、非洲卫生工作者的平等获得，以及研究用药物是否应只限于试验。

Explains that benefit sharing may not fully apply to new treatments developed during emergencies, because the aim is reducing harm and production capacity is limited. It notes that access to investigational treatments for deadly diseases has long been contested, citing the 1980s struggle over antiretroviral therapy.
解释惠益分享可能不完全适用于突发事件期间开发的新疗法，因为其目的在于减少伤害，而且生产能力有限。指出致命疾病研究用治疗的获得长期存在争议，并举出20世纪80年代围绕抗逆转录病毒治疗的斗争。

Lists sources of access inequity, such as physician gatekeeping, patients unable to join trials, production limits and new treatments not yet widely available. It states the unit first explores ways to increase access before fairness, starting with reducing regulatory restrictions.
列出获得不公平的来源，如医生把关、病人无法参加试验、生产限制以及新疗法尚未广泛可得。说明本单元先探讨增加获得的途径，再讨论公平，首先是减少监管限制。

Presents the debate over loosening regulation of investigational drugs in emergencies, with critics warning it could harm research and patients. It also discusses alternative trial designs such as stepped-wedge cluster randomized trials and their methodological and ethical difficulties.
介绍关于在突发事件中放宽研究用药物监管的争论，批评者警告这可能损害研究和病人。还讨论阶梯楔形整群随机试验等替代试验设计及其方法学和伦理难题。

Describes compassionate use programmes under US Food and Drug Administration rules and differing views on their usefulness in pandemics. It also covers removing production and supply barriers, for example through compulsory licensing or rebuilding infrastructure, and identifying the minimum effective dose.
描述美国食品药品监督管理局规则下的同情使用项目，以及对其在大流行中作用的不同看法。还涉及消除生产和供应障碍（例如通过强制许可或重建基础设施）以及确定最低有效剂量。

Turns to fairness concerns, noting that access to investigational drugs is usually limited to enrolled participants under strict criteria and trial locations. It warns that geographically defined cluster trials in emergencies may let political power shape who gets promising treatments and worsen existing inequalities.
转向公平问题，指出研究用药物的获得通常仅限于按照严格标准和试验地点入组的参与者。警告突发事件中按地理划分的整群试验可能让政治权力左右谁能获得有前景的治疗，并加剧现有的不平等。

Notes that people excluded from trials in an emergency may see similar risks either way, and that severe shortages create conflicts of interest when organizations prioritise their own members. It then opens the case study on filovirus outbreaks in Africa, with high fatality rates and no approved treatments.
指出突发事件中被排除在试验之外的人无论如何可能面临相似的风险，严重短缺会在组织优先照顾自身成员时造成利益冲突。随后开始介绍非洲丝状病毒暴发的案例研究：病死率高，且没有获批的治疗。

Questions whether the experimental post-exposure vaccine given to a laboratory scientist could be made equally available to exposed African health workers. A box describes a scientist in Hamburg isolated after a needle-stick injury with possible Ebola exposure and given an experimental vaccine.
质疑给一名实验室科学家使用的实验性暴露后疫苗能否同样提供给受暴露的非洲卫生工作者。一个专栏描述了汉堡一名科学家在可能接触埃博拉的针刺伤后被隔离并接种实验性疫苗。

Completes the box, noting the vaccine was developed in Canada and tested in macaques, and that the scientist had a passing fever after vaccination. The summary explains that formal research can both limit access and help distribute burdens and benefits fairly, and that alternative trial designs may help but raise their own issues.
专栏结束，指出该疫苗由加拿大研制并在猕猴身上试验，这名科学家接种后出现一过性发热。小结说明正式研究既可能限制获得，也有助于公平分配负担和惠益，替代试验设计可能有所帮助，但也会带来自身的问题。

The divider page for core competency 7 of the training manual, on the responsibilities of health workers during public health surveillance or research in emergencies.
培训手册核心能力7的分隔页，主题是突发事件期间公共卫生监测或研究中卫生工作者的责任。

Introduces core competency 7, noting ethical conflicts such as the duty to treat infectious patients and the dual role of clinician-researchers. It lists learning objectives on clinical, public health and research ethics frameworks, therapeutic misconception and conflicts of interest for health workers in emergency research.
介绍核心能力7，指出治疗传染病病人的义务以及临床医生兼研究者的双重角色等伦理冲突。列出的学习目标涉及临床、公共卫生和研究伦理框架、治疗误解，以及突发事件期间研究中卫生工作者的利益冲突。

Opens learning objective 7.1, by Leigh-Anne Gillespie and Lisa Schwartz, on distinguishing clinical, public health and research ethics, with a 105-minute session plan. Learners compare the three frameworks using a template and discuss a video on conflicts between public health and clinical ethics in disasters.
学习目标7.1开篇，作者Leigh-Anne Gillespie和Lisa Schwartz，内容是区分临床伦理、公共卫生伦理和研究伦理，附105分钟课程时间表。学员用模板比较三个框架，并讨论一段关于灾害中公共卫生伦理与临床伦理冲突的视频。

Lists questions on which framework has moral authority in emergencies and on a case study involving collecting data before ethics approval and paying participants to stay in contact. It introduces a role-play and a template comparing the duties and principles of the three frameworks.
列出问题：在突发事件中哪个框架具有道德权威，以及一个涉及在获得伦理批准前收集数据并付钱让参与者保持联系的案例研究。介绍角色扮演和一个比较三个框架的义务和原则的模板。

Summarises the distinct aims of clinical care, public health and research ethics, noting published codes for each and that their principles can conflict in certain settings. It begins describing clinical ethics as focused on the individual patient's autonomy and best interests.
概述临床照护、公共卫生和研究伦理各自的目标，指出每一领域都有已发布的准则，而它们的原则在某些情况下可能相互冲突。开始描述以病人个体的自主权和最大利益为中心的临床伦理。

Describes public health ethics as focused on population benefit and collective action, and research ethics as producing generalisable knowledge while limiting the use of people as means. It discusses choosing the dominant framework without discarding duties from the others.
描述以人群受益和集体行动为中心的公共卫生伦理，以及旨在产生可推广知识、同时限制把人当作手段的研究伦理。讨论如何选择占主导地位的框架而不抛弃其他框架的义务。

Notes that setting aside one framework can sometimes mean stricter protections, giving the example of privacy safeguards when consent is waived during SARS. It discusses the problem of multiple roles, stressing that health workers' duties and loyalties should be clearly defined.
指出搁置某一框架有时意味着更严格的保护，并举出SARS期间豁免知情同意时的隐私保障为例。讨论多重角色问题，强调卫生工作者的义务和忠诚应明确界定。

Describes role-play scenarios on consent in clinical care, public health outbreak management and a randomized trial of tuberculosis treatment. The summary states that clinicians must understand the differences among the three frameworks and that the best interventions serve both individual and community interests.
描述角色扮演情景，涉及临床照护中的知情同意、公共卫生暴发管理以及一项结核病治疗随机试验。小结指出临床医生必须了解三个框架之间的差异，最好的干预措施应同时服务于个人和社区的利益。
