Opens learning objective 7.2, by Elysee Nouvet, Lisa Schwartz and Michael Baxter, on therapeutic misconception and health workers' duties in emergencies, with a 75-minute session plan. Learners discuss strategies to help people tell research from care and how language barriers and scarce resources affect them.
学习目标7.2开篇，作者Elysee Nouvet、Lisa Schwartz和Michael Baxter，内容是突发事件中的治疗误解和卫生工作者的义务，附75分钟课程时间表。学员讨论帮助人们区分研究与照护的策略，以及语言障碍和资源匮乏对此的影响。

Lists case-study questions on whether a doctor should exclude a patient who cannot tell research from treatment. It describes a role-play of a dengue vaccine or placebo trial in Brazil between a health worker and a parent, with aims and instructions for the facilitator.
列出案例研究问题：医生是否应排除一名无法区分研究与治疗的病人。描述在巴西开展的一项登革热疫苗或安慰剂试验中卫生工作者与家长之间的角色扮演，并为教员说明目的和做法。

Notes the risks if parents do not understand a vaccine trial, such as skipping follow-up or dropping mosquito protection. The background defines therapeutic misconception and explains how clinical settings and dual clinician-researcher roles blur the line between treatment and research.
指出如果家长不理解疫苗试验可能带来的风险，如不参加随访或放弃防蚊措施。背景部分界定了治疗误解，并解释临床环境和临床医生兼研究者的双重角色如何模糊治疗与研究之间的界限。

Explains that therapeutic misconception undermines informed and voluntary consent and the integrity of research, and can lead to resentment or withdrawal when expected benefits do not appear. It states that health workers have an important role in reducing this risk during emergencies.
解释治疗误解会破坏知情和自愿同意以及研究的完整性，当预期的益处没有出现时还可能导致不满或退出。指出卫生工作者在突发事件期间降低这一风险方面发挥重要作用。

Describes how the heightened authority and gratitude given to health workers, especially foreign ones, during emergencies can increase therapeutic misconception. It gives the example of Japanese medical teams measuring radiation exposure after the 2011 nuclear accident, whose work may have been mistaken for treatment.
描述突发事件期间人们给予卫生工作者（尤其是外国卫生工作者）更高的权威和感激，可能加剧治疗误解。举例说明2011年核事故后日本医疗队测量辐射暴露的工作可能被误认为是治疗。

States that researchers must make sure participants understand the limits of research interventions and that people who refuse to take part still receive usual care. It then describes strategies against therapeutic misconception, starting with disclosure by a neutral, knowledgeable third party and moving to community consultation.
指出研究者必须确保参与者理解研究干预措施的局限性，拒绝参加研究的人仍应获得常规治疗。随后介绍降低治疗性误解的策略，先是由与研究无关、知识渊博的中立第三方披露信息，继而是社区咨询。

Explains that community information meetings before research, even if brief in emergencies, can reduce misconception and build trust, though they do not replace individual consent. It then begins the HIV case study with background on the history and spread of HIV and AIDS.
说明在研究前召开社区信息会议（紧急情况下可能较简短）可以降低治疗性误解并建立信任，但不能取代个人知情同意。随后开始HIV案例研究，介绍HIV和艾滋病的历史与传播背景。

Presents the case of Justin, a 38-year-old in Los Angeles with drug-resistant HIV who has run out of effective antiretroviral combinations and is offered a place in a phase III trial by his doctor. It then begins background on dengue for the role-play, noting its global burden and four serotypes.
介绍Justin的案例：他是洛杉矶一名38岁男子，所感染的HIV已产生耐药性，有效的抗反转录病毒药物组合已经用尽，医生建议他参加一项III期试验。随后为角色扮演提供登革热背景，指出其全球负担和四种血清型。

Describes a dengue epidemic in Brazil, with many cases and child deaths in Rio de Janeiro, and a planned double-blind vaccine trial in schoolchildren after promising early-phase results, with extra health resources for the community. It sets up a role-play in which a nurse faces an anxious parent and gives role information.
描述巴西的登革热流行，里约热内卢出现大量病例和儿童死亡；在早期阶段结果令人鼓舞后，计划在学龄儿童中开展双盲疫苗试验，并为社区提供额外卫生资源。本页设置了一个角色扮演：护士面对一位焦虑的家长，并给出角色信息。

Gives the role brief for the parent in the dengue role-play, who lost a brother to dengue and is determined that both children receive the vaccine despite the placebo arm. The summary defines therapeutic misconception and explains that it undermines voluntary informed consent.
给出登革热角色扮演中家长的角色说明：这位家长的兄弟死于登革热，尽管试验设有安慰剂组，仍决意让两个孩子都接种疫苗。小结部分界定了治疗性误解，并解释它会破坏自愿的知情同意。

Opens learning objective 7.3, by Marie-Josée Potvin and Bryn Williams-Jones, on potential conflicts of interest for health workers taking part in emergency research, with an interactive 90-minute session plan. Facilitators present definitions, tools for identifying and managing conflicts of interest and a staged case study.
开始学习目标7.3（作者Marie-Josée Potvin和Bryn Williams-Jones），内容是卫生保健人员参加紧急情况下研究活动的潜在利益冲突，并附90分钟互动课程时间表。教员介绍定义、识别和管理利益冲突的工具以及分阶段的案例研究。

Closes the session plan and notes that public health research involves many stakeholders whose interests may conflict. It argues it is unrealistic to expect researchers to manage conflicts in the midst of an emergency and that they must be familiar with the concept beforehand through training.
结束课程时间表，并指出公共卫生研究涉及许多利益可能相互冲突的利益相关者。文中认为，期望研究者在紧急情况当中处理利益冲突是不现实的，他们必须事先通过培训熟悉这一概念。

Notes that 'conflict of interest' is often seen as implying misconduct because of publicised scandals such as an industry-linked meningitis study in Nigeria. It argues this negative view makes the concept hard to use, since conflicts of interest are common and not blameworthy in themselves, and discusses definitions linked to judgement and disclosure.
指出由于广为宣传的丑闻（如尼日利亚一项与企业有关的脑膜炎研究），“利益冲突”常被视为意味着不端行为。文中认为这种负面看法使该概念难以运用，因为利益冲突很常见，本身并不应受指责，并讨论了与判断和披露相关的定义。

Distinguishes role conflicts, such as between clinician and researcher duties in emergencies, from conflicts of interest, which arise when one role's interests undermine another's duties. It calls for personal reflection and collective analysis and suggests identifying all stakeholders and their interests.
区分角色冲突（如紧急情况下临床医生与研究者职责之间的冲突）与利益冲突（一种角色的利益损害另一种角色的职责时产生）。呼吁进行个人反思和集体分析，并建议识别所有利益相关者及其利益。

Notes that research-related conflicts may involve local politics and community leaders seeking prestige, and that vulnerable groups may be unable to judge or resist others' interests. It gives the example of a lead investigator who is also a health worker and a shareholder in the drug company, and notes risks to trust in researchers.
指出与研究相关的冲突可能涉及当地政治以及谋求声望的社区领导，弱势群体可能无法判断或抵制他人的利益。举例说明主要研究者同时是卫生保健人员和药企股东的情形，并指出这会危及对研究者的信任。

Begins a case study in which a West African mining company's employee welfare group asks a European university team to assess the economic impact of AIDS on its workforce. The team reviews anonymised records of employees who left due to AIDS-related illness and uses national survey data on HIV prevalence.
开始一个案例研究：西非一家矿业公司的员工福利小组请欧洲一所大学的研究团队评估艾滋病对其劳动力的经济影响。研究团队查阅因艾滋病相关疾病离职员工的匿名记录，并使用全国HIV流行率调查数据。

Continues the case: the company fully funds the study and promises publication freedom, but a union official warns the company may use the results to push out HIV-positive workers through insurance testing and downsizing. The team raises concerns with the funder, who denies misuse, and a research assistant asks for written assurances.
案例继续：公司全额资助研究并承诺不限制发表，但一名工会官员警告，公司可能利用研究结果通过保险检测和裁员排挤HIV阳性员工。研究团队向资助方提出担忧，资助方否认会滥用结果，一名研究助理要求获得书面保证。

Describes the company's chief executive warning that covering HIV treatment costs could force bankruptcy or relocation and asking the team to recommend capping health insurance benefits for HIV-positive staff. He argues shifting costs to governments, families and others is a reasonable business response and counts on the team's reputation to support it.
描述公司首席执行官警告说，承担HIV治疗费用可能导致公司破产或迁址，并要求研究团队建议对HIV阳性员工的医疗保险待遇设定上限。他认为将费用转嫁给政府、家庭等方面是合理的商业应对，并指望借助研究团队的声誉支持这一做法。

Gives a facilitator table identifying the main actors in the case, such as the research team, the welfare group, the company, workers, the union, community groups, NGOs, shareholders and political actors, with their actual or potential interests.
提供一份供教员使用的表格，列出案例中的主要行动者，如研究团队、福利小组、公司、工人、工会、社区团体、非政府组织、股东和政治行动者，以及他们实际或潜在的利益。

Lists possible conflicts of interest for the researchers in the case, such as company pressure if results contradict its agenda and union pressure if results go against workers. For each it notes likely consequences, such as tension or biased analysis, and rates the risk.
列出案例中研究者可能面临的利益冲突，例如结果与公司议程相悖时来自公司的压力，以及结果不利于工人时来自工会的压力。对每种情况都注明可能的后果（如关系紧张或分析偏倚）并评定风险等级。

Gives questions for the later stages of the case on how new information changes the analysis and what conflicts arise. It closes with key messages, such as reducing avoidable conflicts early, agreeing solutions within the team, preparing in advance and seeking expert advice.
给出案例后续部分的问题，探讨新信息如何改变分析以及出现了哪些利益冲突。最后列出关键信息，如及早减少可避免的冲突、在团队内部商定解决办法、事先做好准备以及寻求专家意见。

Summarises that identifying and managing conflicts of interest in emergency research requires reflection, preparation and ongoing analysis, and that the unit offers a practical way to discuss these often taboo issues and learn from experience.
总结指出，识别和管理紧急情况下研究中的利益冲突需要反思、准备和持续分析，本单元为讨论这些常被视为禁忌的问题并从经验中学习提供了实用途径。
A near-blank page with only a 'further reading' heading and translator credits.
近乎空白的一页，只有“其他读物”标题和译校者署名。
The glossary divider page, with a photo caption describing hospital records staff in Galle, Sri Lanka, using computers and Epi Info training provided by WHO after the tsunami.
术语表的分隔页，图片说明描述斯里兰卡加勒一家医院的病案室工作人员在使用世界卫生组织于海啸后提供的电脑和Epi Info软件培训。
Opens the glossary of health ethics terms, noting that many terms have several definitions. It defines accountability for reasonableness, autonomy, beneficence and bioethics.
开始健康伦理学术语表，指出许多术语有多种定义。本页定义了合理性问责、自主、有利（行善）和生命伦理学。
Continues the glossary with definitions of distributive justice, egalitarianism, equity and ethics.
术语表续，给出分配公正、平等主义、公平和伦理学的定义。
Continues the glossary with definitions of justice, liberty, non-maleficence, principle, privacy and procedural justice.
术语表续，给出正义、自由、不伤害、原则、隐私和程序公正的定义。
Continues the glossary with definitions of public health ethics, reciprocity, social justice, solidarity and utilitarianism.
术语表续，给出公共健康伦理、互惠、社会公正、团结和功利主义的定义。
A near-blank page with only the heading for the glossary's reference list.
近乎空白的一页，只有术语表参考文献的标题。
A near-blank page with only translator credits for the glossary.
近乎空白的一页，只有术语表的译校者署名。
The divider page for annex 1, listing modules and course timetables, with a photo credit from a refugee camp in Goma.
附录1（单元列表和课程时间表）的分隔页，附有一张来自戈马难民营的图片来源说明。

Lists the training modules of the Chinese edition of the WHO ethics training manual for epidemics, emergencies and disasters, starting with the overview and core competencies 1–3 on surveillance and research. Each learning objective, such as distinguishing surveillance from research or identifying when ethics review is needed, is given with its time allocation in minutes.
列出世界卫生组织《疾病流行、突发事件和灾害情况下的伦理学》培训手册中文版的培训单元，从概述以及关于监测和研究的核心能力1～3开始。每个学习目标（如区分监测与研究、确定何时需要伦理审查）均注明以分钟计的时间安排。

Continues the module list with learning objectives for core competencies 3–5, covering informed consent, privacy, protection of data and biological samples, harms and benefits of emergency research and publication ethics. Each objective carries a suggested duration in minutes.
单元列表续，列出核心能力3～5的学习目标，涵盖知情同意、隐私、数据和生物样本的保护、紧急情况下研究的危害和利益以及发表伦理。每个学习目标都标有建议时长（分钟）。

Completes the module list with core competencies 6 and 7 on triage, resource allocation, standards of care, access to unproven treatment and the duties of health workers. Translator and reviewer credits close the page.
完成单元列表，列出关于检伤、资源分配、治疗规范、获得未经证实的治疗以及卫生保健人员职责的核心能力6和7。页末为译校者署名。

Opens the course schedules with day one of a two-day, practice-oriented course, giving times for each session. Sessions cover distinguishing surveillance from research, the three ethical frameworks, triage and allocation, and changes in standards of care.
开始课程时间表，列出为期2天、以实践为导向课程的第1天，并给出每节课的时间。课程内容包括区分监测与研究、三种伦理框架、检伤与分配以及治疗规范的变化。

Gives the day-two timetable of the practice-oriented course. Sessions cover ethics review of surveillance, informed consent, privacy and confidentiality, benefit sharing and the protection of data and biological materials.
给出以实践为导向课程的第2天时间表。课程内容包括监测的伦理审查、知情同意、隐私和保密、利益分享以及数据和生物材料的保护。

Ends the practice-oriented schedule with a session on publishing surveillance data and starts the timetable for a two-day, research-oriented course. Day one sessions cover surveillance versus research, ethical frameworks, defining research in emergencies and the harms and benefits of research.
以关于发表监测数据的一节课结束以实践为导向的时间表，并开始为期2天、以研究为导向课程的时间表。第1天的课程包括监测与研究的区别、伦理框架、紧急情况下研究的界定以及研究的危害和利益。

Gives the remaining sessions of the research-oriented course, including standard ethics review, conflicts of interest, therapeutic misconception, informed consent in low-resource settings, fair access to unproven treatment and data ownership. Translator credits appear at the end.
给出以研究为导向课程的其余各节，包括标准伦理审查、利益冲突、治疗性误解、资源匮乏环境中的知情同意、公平获得未经证实的治疗以及数据所有权。页末为译者署名。
The divider page for Appendix 2 on case studies, with a photo caption describing doctors checking a patient at a supported hospital in South Sudan in 2011.
附录2（案例研究）的分隔页，图片说明描述2011年医生在南苏丹一家受支持的医院查看病人。

Presents case study 1 on a viral haemorrhagic fever outbreak, in which a nurse trained in ethics must plan how to prioritise scarce intravenous fluids. The scenario also asks whether and how to allocate a very limited supply of an experimental drug.
介绍案例研究1：病毒性出血热暴发，一名受过伦理学培训的护士必须规划如何优先分配稀缺的静注液体。情景还提出是否以及如何分配极其有限的实验性药物。

Lists discussion questions for the haemorrhagic fever case on who decides, whether to give experimental treatment, allocation by need or demographics, appeals and communication. It then begins a second group scenario about running a clinical trial during the same outbreak.
列出出血热案例的讨论问题，涉及由谁决策、是否提供实验治疗、按需要还是按人口学特征分配、申诉和沟通。随后开始第二组情景，内容是在同一次暴发期间开展临床试验。

Continues the clinical trial scenario, in which a consortium asks a health centre to test an antiviral drug proven only in animals. Thirteen discussion questions address study design, recruitment, informed consent, effects on non-participants, dual roles of health workers, publication and duties to the community.
临床试验情景继续：一个合作联盟请卫生保健中心试验一种仅在动物身上证实有效的抗病毒药物。十三个讨论问题涉及研究设计、招募、知情同意、对非参与者的影响、卫生保健人员的双重角色、发表以及对社区的责任。

Introduces case study 2 on an Ebola outbreak in Central Africa, asking a clinician how to respond to requests for blood, saliva and bone marrow samples from isolation-ward patients. It begins a second scenario about testing a candidate therapy without a national research ethics committee.
介绍案例研究2：中部非洲埃博拉出血热暴发，询问临床医生应如何回应从隔离病房患者采集血液、唾液和骨髓样本的请求。随后开始第二个情景，内容是在没有国家研究伦理委员会的情况下试验一种候选疗法。

Completes the Ebola case with questions on consent from disoriented patients and a third scenario on restricted autopsies amid community rumours. Each scenario asks how the research–practice distinction bears on the clinician's decision.
完成埃博拉案例，提出关于从意识不清的患者获得同意的问题，以及第三个情景：在社区谣言四起的情况下进行受限尸检。每个情景都要求思考研究与实践的区别如何影响临床医生的决定。
Case study 3 on meningitis in Nigeria, which points readers to a 2000 newspaper report on the Trovan trial and a related company fact sheet.
案例研究3：尼日利亚的脑膜炎，引导读者阅读2000年一篇关于Trovan试验的报纸报道和一份相关的公司情况说明。

Presents case study 4 on the 2003 SARS outbreak, describing how the US CDC traced airline passengers and asked for blood samples from healthy contacts after long delays. The questions ask what research question this might involve and what an ethics committee would raise.
介绍案例研究4：2003年SARS暴发，描述美国疾病预防控制中心如何追踪航班乘客，并在长时间延误后要求健康接触者提供血样。问题要求思考这可能涉及什么研究问题，以及伦理委员会会提出什么问题。

Finishes the SARS case by noting the activity was classed as surveillance rather than research, and asks learners to discuss the difficulty of that classification. Small groups then debate the value and cost of research ethics oversight.
结束SARS案例，指出该活动被归类为监测而非研究，并请学员讨论这种归类的难处。随后各小组辩论研究伦理监督的价值和代价。

Presents case study 5 on monitoring protein-calorie malnutrition in hospital patients with several laboratory markers. It describes a design in which results are shared with patients in one group but withheld in a control group.
介绍案例研究5：利用多项实验室指标监测住院患者的蛋白质-热量营养不良。描述一种设计：一组患者可获知检测结果，而对照组则不告知。

Gives discussion questions for the malnutrition case on why formal review is needed, whether the project was rightly classed as research, and alternatives. Groups then debate which kinds of surveillance should undergo ethics review.
给出营养不良案例的讨论问题，涉及为何需要正式审查、该项目被归类为研究是否正确以及替代方案。随后各小组辩论哪些类型的监测应接受伦理审查。

Presents case study 6 on fast-tracked ethics review of a new vaccine for a deadly pathogen, distributed through retail outlets without community consent. A second scenario describes a bioterrorism detection system that collects identifiable pharmacy, emergency department and absenteeism data.
介绍案例研究6：对一种针对致命病原体的新疫苗进行快速伦理审查，该疫苗未经社区同意即通过零售网点分发。第二个情景描述一个生物恐怖袭击探测系统，收集可识别身份的药房、急诊科和旷工数据。

Completes the bioterrorism surveillance scenario and asks groups whether the projects are research or surveillance. The questions cover the need for ethics review, changes to standard procedures, consent forms and expedited review.
完成生物恐怖监测情景，请各小组判断这些项目属于研究还是监测。问题涉及伦理审查的必要性、对标准程序的修改、知情同意书和快速审查。

Presents case study 7 on race, in which a clinic director in southern Africa plans a survey linking sexually transmitted infections to self-identified race. A community member of the ethics committee objects to including race in the questions.
介绍案例研究7：种族问题，非洲南部一家诊所的主任计划开展一项将性传播感染与自我认定种族相关联的调查。伦理委员会的一名社区成员反对在问题中纳入种族。

Continues the race case with the community representative's concerns about stigma and the director's arguments for the research. Discussion questions ask about harms and benefits, responsibility for misuse of findings and surveying without informed consent.
种族案例继续，介绍社区代表对污名化的担忧以及主任支持该研究的理由。讨论问题涉及危害和利益、对研究结果被滥用的责任以及在未获知情同意的情况下开展调查。

Presents case study 8 on multidrug-resistant tuberculosis in a fictional low-income island state, where officials propose anonymous drug-resistance testing of sampled patients. Questions ask whether this is surveillance or research, what the risks are and whether consent is required.
介绍案例研究8：一个虚构的低收入岛国中的耐多药结核病，官员提议对抽样患者进行匿名耐药检测。问题要求判断这属于监测还是研究、存在哪些风险以及是否需要知情同意。
Ends the tuberculosis case with questions on whether community consultation is needed and how its findings should be used.
结束结核病案例，提出是否需要进行社区咨询以及如何使用咨询所得信息的问题。

Presents case study 9 on cross-cultural communication, in which a village leader demands to see completed survey forms during an NGO needs assessment. Questions ask whether the team should comply and what privacy and confidentiality measures are needed.
介绍案例研究9：跨文化交流，一个非政府组织开展需求评估时，村长要求查看已填写的调查表。问题要求思考团队是否应当照办，以及需要采取哪些隐私和保密措施。

Presents case study 10 on a new lethal influenza virus, where a government asks an aid agency to collect blood samples and questionnaires door to door. Questions cover what to tell participants, re-identification risks, safeguards, feedback of results and conditions for a European vaccine maker using the samples.
介绍案例研究10：一种新的致命流感病毒，政府请一家援助机构挨家挨户采集血样并填写问卷。问题涉及应告知参与者什么、重新识别身份的风险、保障措施、结果反馈，以及一家欧洲疫苗生产商使用这些样本的条件。

Presents case study 11 on a man with possible extensively drug-resistant tuberculosis who goes into hiding to avoid isolation. Questions ask whether publishing his name and photograph is justified and how transmission risk affects that judgement.
介绍案例研究11：一名男子可能感染广泛耐药结核病，为逃避隔离而躲藏起来。问题要求思考公布他的姓名和照片是否合理，以及传播风险如何影响这一判断。
Closes the drug-resistant tuberculosis case with questions on what level of onward transmission would justify publishing the man's photograph and how long compulsory isolation could ethically last.
结束耐药结核病案例，提出以下问题：传染他人达到何种程度才可以公布该男子的照片，以及强制隔离在伦理上可以持续多久。

Opens case study 12 on SARS in Toronto, recounting how the virus was carried from a Hong Kong hotel to a Canadian woman whose death was not attributed to SARS. It describes the spread to family, emergency room patients and hospital staff, and the wider disruption to schools, work and hospitals.
开始案例研究12：多伦多的SARS，讲述病毒如何从香港一家酒店传给一名加拿大妇女，而她的死亡当时未被归因于SARS。描述疾病向家人、急诊室患者和医院工作人员的传播，以及对学校、工作和医院造成的更广泛干扰。

Continues the Toronto SARS case, describing unmeasured indirect harms, confusion over privacy law that hampered data sharing, and barriers to research such as funding and multiple ethics approvals. It notes that no Canadian authors or patients appeared in a key international paper on the SARS coronavirus, and closes with questions on principles, benefits and risks.
多伦多SARS案例继续，描述未被测量的间接危害、隐私法方面的混乱阻碍了数据共享，以及资金和多重伦理审批等研究障碍。指出在一篇关于SARS冠状病毒的重要国际论文中没有加拿大作者或患者，最后提出关于原则、益处和风险的问题。

Presents case study 13 on oseltamivir, describing a company-sponsored 2003 analysis that pooled ten trials, only two of them published. It explains that a later Cochrane review found insufficient evidence once the unpublished data were set aside, even though the drug had been widely stockpiled for pandemics.
介绍案例研究13：奥司他韦，描述2003年由公司资助、汇总了十项试验（其中仅两项已发表）的分析。解释后来的Cochrane综述在剔除未发表数据后发现证据不足，尽管该药已被广泛储备以应对大流行。

Lists discussion questions on publication bias in the oseltamivir case, how it might be prevented and how it affects emergency response. Further questions ask which data should inform public health decisions and whether withheld research data undermines ethics committees and scientific value.
列出关于奥司他韦案例中发表偏倚的讨论问题，包括如何预防发表偏倚及其如何影响突发事件应对。其他问题询问哪些数据应为公共卫生决策提供依据，以及隐瞒研究数据是否会削弱伦理委员会的作用和科学价值。

Continues the questions on data ownership, asking how researchers, public health staff and publishers should share different types of data and whether emergency data deserve priority. Further questions address who should access the oseltamivir data and the responsibilities of regulators deciding without full data.
关于数据所有权的问题继续，询问研究人员、公共卫生人员和出版商应如何共享不同类型的数据，以及突发事件数据是否应享有优先。其他问题涉及谁应获得奥司他韦数据，以及监管机构在没有完整数据的情况下作决定时的责任。

Presents case study 14 on triage during a severe influenza pandemic, where two hospitals adopt different rules for emergency surgery. A surgeon must decide whether to break his hospital's rule limiting care to patients expected to live over six months in order to operate on a young mother with ovarian cancer.
介绍案例研究14：严重流感大流行期间的检伤，两家医院对急诊手术采用了不同规则。一名外科医生必须决定是否违反本院只治疗预期存活超过六个月患者的规定，为一位患卵巢癌的年轻母亲做手术。
Completes the triage case, noting there may be no single right course of action, and asks groups to decide what the surgeon should do and why.
完成检伤案例，指出可能没有唯一正确的行动方案，并请各小组决定外科医生应当怎么做及其理由。

Presents case study 15 on Indonesia's 2007 refusal to send avian influenza H5N1 samples to WHO collaborating centres. It sets out the argument of "viral sovereignty" against the view that viruses cross borders and that pandemic risk outweighs national ownership claims.
介绍案例研究15：印度尼西亚2007年拒绝向世界卫生组织合作中心送交H5N1禽流感样本。文中阐述“病毒主权”的论点，以及与之相对的观点：病毒跨越国界，大流行风险重于国家所有权主张。
Ends the Indonesia case with three questions on the ethical arguments for keeping samples, for joining global virus sharing and for vaccine makers sharing benefits.
以三个问题结束印度尼西亚案例，涉及保留样本、参与全球病毒共享以及疫苗生产商分享利益的伦理论据。

Presents case study 16 on a Hamburg scientist who pricked herself with an Ebola-contaminated needle and received an experimental vaccine never before used in humans. It describes her isolation, the brief appearance of vaccine virus in her blood and the rapid international response that supplied the vaccine.
介绍案例研究16：汉堡一名科学家被埃博拉病毒污染的针头刺伤，接受了一种从未在人体使用过的实验性疫苗。描述她的隔离、疫苗病毒在其血液中短暂出现，以及提供疫苗的迅速国际响应。

Completes the Hamburg Ebola case with details of the vaccine's development and the scientist's mild reaction. Six questions ask about compassionate use, reciprocity, equal access for African health workers, trial design and who benefits from filovirus treatment research.
完成汉堡埃博拉案例，介绍疫苗的研发情况和该科学家的轻微反应。六个问题涉及同情用药、互惠、非洲卫生保健人员的平等获得、试验设计以及谁从丝状病毒治疗研究中获益。

Presents case study 17 on HIV/AIDS, reviewing the disease's history, opportunistic infections such as Pneumocystis pneumonia and drug resistance. It introduces Justin, a long-term injecting drug user in Los Angeles whose HIV has become resistant to his antiretroviral treatment.
介绍案例研究17：艾滋病，回顾该病的历史、肺囊虫肺炎等机会性感染以及耐药问题。介绍Justin，他是洛杉矶一名长期静脉吸毒者，所感染的HIV已对其抗反转录病毒治疗产生耐药性。

Continues Justin's case, in which his doctor, who is also the principal investigator, suggests he join a phase III trial of a new antiretroviral combination. Questions explore how therapeutic misconception may arise, how to reduce it and whether it is ever ethically acceptable.
Justin的案例继续：他的医生同时也是主要研究者，建议他参加一种新抗反转录病毒药物组合的III期试验。问题探讨治疗性误解可能如何产生、如何减少，以及在伦理上是否可以接受。

Presents case study 18, in which a European university team is asked by a West African mining company's welfare group to estimate the economic impact of HIV/AIDS on its workforce. The welfare group hopes the findings will persuade management to fund prevention programmes and services.
介绍案例研究18：西非一家矿业公司的员工福利小组请欧洲一所大学的团队估算艾滋病对其劳动力的经济影响。福利小组希望研究结果能说服管理层资助预防规划和服务。

Continues the mining company case, in which a union official warns the company may use the findings to remove HIV-positive workers and a research assistant demands written assurances. The team's conclusions on staff turnover and rising health care costs are listed.
矿业公司案例继续：一名工会官员警告公司可能利用研究结果清退HIV阳性员工，一名研究助理要求获得书面保证。文中列出研究团队关于员工流失和医疗费用上升的结论。

Concludes the mining case, in which the chief executive asks the researchers to recommend capping health insurance benefits for HIV-positive staff. Questions ask how each new element changes the analysis and what conflicts of interest arise.
矿业公司案例结束：首席执行官要求研究人员建议对HIV阳性员工的医疗保险待遇设定上限。问题询问每个新要素如何改变分析以及出现了哪些利益冲突。
